Black,David J. H. Wu,Austin Schoeffler,John Lyon Havlik,Elizabeth C. Stade,Jared Moore,Johannes C. Eichstaedt,Logan Pierce,Jeff Jopling,Johannes Thrul,Thomas H. McCoy,Neguine Rezaii,Mark S. Chen,Ellen E. Fitzsimmons-Craft,Shirley Wang,Desmond C. Ong,Katharina Schultebraucks,Torrey Creed,Bhavna Daryani,Aleksandra Faust,S. Sara Mahdavi,Caroline Figueroa,Eric Lin,Kate H. Bentley,Ernest Lim,Zhihan Jiang,Xuhai "Orson" Xu,Daniel McDuff,John Torous,Yun Liu,Po-Hsuan Cameron Chen,Mike Schaekermann,Joelle Barral,Alvin Rajkomar,Tao Tu,Lin Yang,Isaac Galatzer-Levy,David Racz,Valentin Liévin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 多轮强化学习训练的对话代理在模拟环境中显著提升精神科结构式接诊能力（病史采集、鉴别诊断、初始处置），并降低急性安全风险分诊不足率，但仍有残余差距需临床监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神科临床接诊访谈是核心诊断工具，需在建立医患关系的同时厘清复杂重叠的临床表现；探索能否通过多轮强化学习在模拟环境中训练语言模型胜任此类结构化文本接诊。

Method: 在模拟环境中进行多轮强化学习训练；采用随机、双盲、交叉设计（60对匹配情景、120次接诊），由32名委员会认证精神科医生扮演标准化患者，另由15名独立认证精神科医生对去标识化转录文本盲评；构建两项德尔菲共识分类法（临床安全风险、关系胜任力），衍生256个对抗性挑战情景用于安全性压力测试。

Result: 训练代理在76.7%匹配情景对中优于基座模型（p<0.0001）；改编临床考核量表效应量 d_z=0.77（p<0.0001）；以患者为中心沟通82.0% vs 65.2%（p<0.001）；鉴别诊断适当性68.3% vs 33.3%（p<0.001）；127个精神科医生验证情景中临床量表分0.706 vs 0.379（p<0.0001）；急性安全风险分诊不足率由30.5%降至12.9%（p<0.0001）。

Conclusion: 模拟环境为训练与压力测试精神科对话代理提供了受控试验平台，训练收益可迁移至真实精神科医生扮演的接诊情景，但仍存在残余差距，需配套安全防护措施与临床医生监督。

Abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

</details>


### [146] [FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40482)
*Yunbai Zhang,Yunyi Gao,Han-Tai Shiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 FIRME——一种以注册表为锚的记忆图，将持续到来的观测归并对齐到持久化的规范关系，并保留来源、时间与上下文，从而解决知识图谱中因表面形式不同导致关系历史碎片化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融AI工作流复用投资者知识时需要持久记忆，跨来源、跨时期整合观测且不丢失身份与溯源。在知识图谱中，反复出现的观测常采用不同表面形式，导致关系历史碎片化、证据无法累积。

Method: FIRME 采用注册表锚定的记忆图：期内基于规则的融合，将投资者电话讨论与组合现金流信号直接关联或经固定产品-主题本体关联；跨期通过规范身份与持久别名把复现观测导向同一关系历史，并以确定性更新汇总强化、沉寂与重激活状态。

Result: 在专有投资者电话与现金流记录及 S&P 500 财报电话文本上评估：相比保留规范身份与语义回退但缺少别名记忆的历史注册表，最终期正确匹配率提升 7.8–12.1 个百分点（四种数据集-后端设置）；每设置200条观测的盲审显示正确匹配率提升 9.0–16.5 点、再关联召回提升 22.5–29.0 点，四样本合并精度均更高；另在投资者电话设置中，完整期内融合的300条输出有293条具备有效证据路径。

Conclusion: 别名记忆与注册表锚定的规范身份能有效缓解关系历史碎片化，提升匹配与再关联性能并保持合并精度与来源可溯性；提取忠实性与往返诊断进一步验证来源接地与抽取图谱内容的保真。

Abstract: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.

</details>


### [147] [Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40492)
*Jingru Fan,Tianle Zhou,Yunjie Zhou,Zihao He,Yixuan Zhou,Kezhao Wu,Xinyu Zheng,Xiyuan Wang,Yuheng Wang,Zhi Li,Songhua Liu,Weinan E,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“人-参与式多智能体组织”（Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization），并实例化为 Agentic University（AU），让学习者作为组织成员与专用智能体协作维护可修订的“能力项目”（Capability Program），使目标、活动与评估对齐并以学习证据驱动后续支持；评估显示在项目组织、评估设计与修订质量上有优势，用户平均评估增益 12.19 vs 5.61（50 分制），并报告更强的认知支持感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型可支持个性化辅导、内容生成与自适应学习路径，但能力发展需要这些资源与交互构成连贯、随学习者演进的学习过程。核心难点在于：如何对齐目标、活动与评估，并利用学习证据决定后续内容。

Method: 提出 Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization 组织范式，并在 Agentic University（AU）中实例化：学习者作为组织成员与多个专用智能体协同，共同维护可修订的 Capability Program，将个人目标、跨模态学习活动与分层评估相连接；学习者反馈与表现用于引导后续支持。

Result: 在项目组织、评估设计与修订质量方面表现更优；用户平均评估增益 12.19 分（对照组 5.61 分，50 分制），并自报更强的认知支持体验。

Conclusion: 该工作提出一种面向自适应学习的组织化方法，使学习者参与成为多智能体协同的持续性基础；项目已开源。

Abstract: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.

</details>


### [148] [Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40503)
*Guancheng Pan,Qixin Tan,Yang Yuan,Andrew Chi-Chih Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出代数世界模型（AWM），将未知环境的交互转化为可形式化推理的显式数学模型，用 Lean 4 证明可达性与不可达性，并在不可解的关卡上给出经内核校验的不可能性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 虽能在 Lean 中给出机器可检验的数学证明，但依赖预先给定的定义与形式化规格；因此核心问题是：AI 能否对一个未知世界进行严格推理。需要一种能从零探索陌生环境并生成可供形式化推理的数学模型的框架。

Method: AWM 先探索环境并生成可执行的 Python 假设，持续用观测检验与修正；再将假设组织为带类型的对象与共享规则，借助范畴论引导的变换简化结构；最后在 Lean 4 中形式化所得模型，证明可达性与不可能性。

Result: 在两个不可解游戏关卡上，AWM 在全部 6 次运行中均构造出排除所有合法获胜序列的、封闭且经内核校验的 Lean 证明，而 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra（配备编码工具）在 12 次基线运行中一次也没有；6 个初始界中 4 个正确（对比 Opus 5.5 为 1 个、GPT-6 Astra 为 0），仅在"存在更廉价胜利"的反馈下修正规则后达到 6/6。在全部 25 个公开 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中，模型使 Lean 重放全部 183 关的获胜轨迹并泛化到未见转移、检测机制变化；配合 Claude Opus 5 时 AWM 通关全部关卡，得分 99.9，认证轨迹仅用人类基线 43% 的动作数。

Conclusion: AWM 表明可将未知环境的交互升级为可解释、可检验、可形式化验证的数学模型，从而超越已探索轨迹给出严格的不可行性证明，并具备泛化与机制变化检测能力，同时显著优于依赖编码工具的基线。

Abstract: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications. This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. AWM can formally prove that a goal is unreachable, even beyond explored trajectories. On two impossible game levels, it constructs closed, kernel-checked Lean proofs excluding every legal winning sequence in all six runs, while Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, equipped with coding tools, produce none in twelve baseline runs. Four of AWM's six initial bounds are correct, compared with one for Opus 5.5 and none for GPT-6 Astra; given only feedback that a cheaper win exists, AWM revises its rules and constructs new proofs, reaching six of six correct bounds. Moreover, AWM produces interpretable mathematical models whose rules can be inspected and tested step by step. Across all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, these models enable Lean to replay the winning trajectories of all 183 levels and generalize beyond observed play, predicting unseen transitions and detecting changes in game mechanics. With Claude Opus 5, AWM clears all levels with a score of 99.9, while its certified winning trajectories use only 43% of the human baseline's actions.

</details>


### [149] [Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40535)
*Ziyi Guan,Yael Tauman Kalai,Ron Rothblum,Zoe Xi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“可回卷交互证明”(RIPs)模型，利用验证者可对AI证明者状态做快照/回卷的能力，为可扩展监督构造出比以往无需诚实证明者假设的相对化证明更高效、且不使用密码学的交互证明协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可扩展监督的核心问题：弱验证者如何检验更强AI系统的计算输出。辩论(debate)虽高效，但assume两个强模型中有一个诚实；已有去除该假设的相对化交互证明代价过高。

Method: 引入RIPs：验证者可将证明者回卷到交互早期状态并继续。针对“输出对少量oracle答案改变鲁棒”的计算类构造相对化RIP，不使用密码学；验证者一次性预处理后运行时间近线性于输入长度。

Result: 诚实证明者运行时间与原计算线性相关；验证者除一次性预处理外近线性于输入长度（可远小于计算本身）；实现协议并在MNIST初步实验中表明RIP可快于现有部署级证明系统。

Conclusion: RIPs为可扩展监督提供更高效、无密码学的相对化证明途径；回卷在验证者控制证明者机器（可信硬件、可检查点虚拟机）时普遍可行，具有独立研究价值。

Abstract: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost.
  In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later restore it. We construct a relativizing RIP for computations whose outputs are robust to changing a small fraction of oracle answers. Our construction is more efficient than prior relativizing proofs that do not assume a truthful prover, and it uses no cryptography.
  In our construction the honest prover runs in time linear in that of the original computation, and the verifier, after a one-time preprocessing step, runs in time nearly linear in the input length (which can be much smaller than the computation itself). We implement our protocol, report a preliminary MNIST experiment, and show that an RIP can be faster than a state-of-the-art deployed proof system.
  RIPs may be of independent interest. Rewinding is possible whenever the verifier controls the prover's machine, for example when the prover runs on trusted hardware or in a virtual machine whose state can be checkpointed.

</details>


### [150] [On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40541)
*Haowen Shi,Xuzhe Yan,Fahao Chen,Peng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出现有预测器评测混淆了预测器质量与任务难度，将解码长度预测的不稳定归因于自回归解码的固有随机性，并用停走随机过程导出每个提示的解码长度近似正态、方差满足 σ=αμ+b 的仿射律及误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用 prefill 阶段隐藏状态预测 LLM 解码 token 数是推理调度的关键原语；但目标模型、数据集或采样配置变化时，已有基准报告的准确率会崩溃，说明评测把预测器质量与任务难度混为一谈，缺少理论上的可辨识性刻画。

Method: 把解码建模为停走随机过程（stopped stochastic process），指出逐步停止概率并非常数而是在数百步内递增，故解码长度由大量局部决策决定并继承中心极限定理，由此得到带显式误差项的逐提示正态性，以及 σ=αμ+b 的仿射方差律（斜率等于响应分段数的变异系数）；并在固定模型、数据、采样条件下比较 MLP、EGTP、FiLM、软标签、MoE 等预测器。

Result: 正态律可在数个百分点内复现逐提示 MAE 与解码长度分布的中心质量，残余的非正态偏离（轻度右偏、轻微超额峰度）与采样噪声修正的预测一致；固定条件下多种预测器设计均收敛到接近理论界的相近性能，表明系统误差主导模型误差。

Conclusion: 主张采用固定模型、数据与采样参数的评测协议，并同时报告相对误差与绝对误差指标；结论是 prefill 侧解码长度预测存在由解码随机性决定的下界，性能差异更多来自系统误差而非预测器结构。

Abstract: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.

</details>


### [151] [Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40545)
*Daniel Strauß,Zhenshan Bing,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出将检索视为在地址空间中的持久局部遍历，分离记忆内容与地址，用代价正则化索引目标平衡信息价值与检索开销，并在 MiniGrid Memory 上以固定几何的最简实例验证有状态检索更易学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型在相邻检索步上反复解决高度相关的检索问题：注意力／全局检索每次前向都重新搜索，循环压缩则需提前决定保留什么。二者都未利用"相邻检索步的有用记忆可能大幅重叠"这一事实。

Method: 把检索建模为对地址空间的持续局部遍历，将记忆内容与地址解耦：效用由检索内容所揭示的信息定义，几何只决定可达代价。据此构造代价正则化索引目标，在局部邻域内保留信息价值，并对每个被设为局部可访问的记忆计费；其边际价值形式产生吸引与排斥两种压力——互补记忆在增量价值超过检索代价时共检索，冗余记忆不因各自有用而占据同一检索集。实验仅测试最简单的固定几何实例（持久局部遍历头）。

Result: 在 MiniGrid Memory 上，五 token 上下文的持久局部遍历头在 0.59M 训练步达到 0.95 平均回报；高斯绝对寻址需 0.94M 步，类别式绝对寻址需超过 2M 步。

Conclusion: 实验未检验学习几何与重复检索，仅作为原理性验证，支持"有状态检索比无状态检索更易学习"的假设；完整方法仍需进一步实验。

Abstract: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve. Neither mechanism directly exploits that useful memories at neighbouring retrieval steps may substantially overlap. We propose an alternative in which retrieval is a persistent local traversal through an address space. We separate a memory's content from its address. Utility is defined by the information revealed by retrieving the content, while geometry determines only how cheaply that information can be reached. This leads to a cost-regularised indexing objective that preserves information value inside local neighbourhoods while charging for every memory made locally accessible. Its marginal-value form gives both attractive and exclusion pressures. Thus, complementary memories should be co-retrievable when the additional value exceeds retrieval cost, whereas redundant memories should not occupy the same retrieval set solely because they are individually useful. As a proof of principle, we test only the simplest fixed-geometry instance on MiniGrid Memory. A persistent local traversal head reaches $0.95$ mean return after $0.59$M training steps with a five-token context, compared with $0.94$M for Gaussian absolute addressing and more than $2$M for categorical absolute addressing. The experiment does not test learned geometry or repeated retrieval. Instead, it motivates the hypothesis that stateful retrieval may be easier to learn than stateless. To test the full proposed method further experimentation is necessary.

</details>


### [152] [Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40551)
*Alan Sorani,Ashvni Narayanan,Michael Shalyt,Tali Monderer,Rotem Kalisch,Hila Barkan,Elyasheev Leibtag,Shachar Weinbaum,Carsten Schneider,John Campbell,Ido Kaminer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 分析Ramanujan Challenge（研究级数论问题基准）的提交结果，衡量各AI模型、CAS与形式化工具的相对表现，并提出一套AI辅助的证明评估流水线以可靠判定自然语言证明、CAS代码与Lean形式化的语义与逻辑正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数学能力快速提升，使有意义的基准从大学水平题目与数学竞赛转向研究级数学；同时，在规模上可靠评判复杂证明本身成为新的难题。

Method: 构建并分析Ramanujan Challenge提交（含未发表结果与公开猜想，其常数公式可数值验证但证明依赖非显然数学）；对比不同AI模型、CAS与形式化工具；设计AI辅助评估流水线，对自然语言证明、CAS代码和Lean形式化进行语义与逻辑正确性核查，并与传统一次性LLM判定对比。

Result: 发现与官方解答概念上截然不同的正确提交，并给出其中一个已发表公开猜想的证明；评估流水线将自然语言证明的假阳性判定率从23%降至6%，并将支撑代码的判定准确率从46%提升至58%。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了在规模上评估研究级数学的方法论，可推广至数学与AI for Science领域。

Abstract: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.

</details>


### [153] [Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40556)
*Qiaoyu Zheng,Weike Zhao,Yanjie Fan,Ye Cao,Mengqi Jiang,Xiao Zhou,Xiaoman Zhang,Pengcheng Qiu,Yongguo Yu,Yanfeng Wang,Ya Zhang,Chaoyi Wu,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出大语言模型智能体ClinGeX，通过105个可执行技能与依赖感知编排辅助临床基因组解读，在基准测试与人类-AI协作研究中显著提升与专家参考分类的一致性并缩短解读时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床基因组分析需专家整合不断演化的指南、数据库与计算证据，流程复杂且耗费人力；测序可及性提升使该过程成为基因组信息及时用于临床决策的主要瓶颈。

Method: 构建LLM智能体ClinGeX，通过任务特定检索与依赖感知编排组合105个经审校的可执行技能；在223例时间留出基准上评估任务级一致性；开展三条件平衡设计的人机协作研究（45名专业人员、135例临床来源病例，分为无AI、DeepSeek辅助、ClinGeX辅助）；并进行为期一个月、11名专家的探索性真实世界非干预评估（96个自选分析案例）。

Result: 基准测试中macro平均任务级一致性达71.7%，最强对照为45.7%；人机协作研究中ClinGeX辅助提升了病例级原始一致性——标准级变异分析51.1%、罕见病基因组解读57.8%、分子肿瘤决策64.4%（对照条件分别为15.6%、31.1%、20.0%），并在所有场景下缩短自报解读时间；真实世界评估中专家频繁采纳结论并报告节省时间。

Conclusion: 可执行领域技能是增强专家基因组解读的有前景路径，ClinGeX在准确性一致性与效率上均优于现有对照方法。

Abstract: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1\%, 57.8\%, 64.4\% versus 15.6\%, 31.1\%, 20.0\% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.

</details>


### [154] [FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40560)
*Di Wu,Ling Liang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FARMS，一个将计算数学文献转化为AI可复用"计算知识"的可靠高效基础设施，在171个随机数值线性代数与数值PDE目标中157个通过流水线，单目标成本约0.85–2.29美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化计算科学需要通过选择、适配与开发数值方法来加速发现，但前提是AI系统能够解释并带显式保证地复用数学知识，现有知识难以直接支撑这一点。

Method: FARMS通过源材料准备、可复用表示与语义审核三个环节，把形式化陈述与来源上下文、算法语义及定量保证相连接；并以Lean检验的蕴含关系，从显式源前提推导至具体计算技能。

Result: 覆盖随机数值线性代数与数值偏微分方程共171个目标，其中157个被流水线接受，跨来源的平均估计成本为每目标0.85–2.29美元；并以热流求解与波形响应压缩两个案例展示了从源前提经Lean检验的蕴含到计算技能的连接。

Conclusion: FARMS为可信的自动化计算科学提供了一个低成本、可复用的知识基础。

Abstract: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees. Here we present FARMS, a faithful and efficient foundation that transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready computing knowledge. FARMS connects formal statements to source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees through source preparation, reusable representations and semantic review. Across 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical partial differential equations, 157 were accepted by the pipeline, with mean estimated costs of US \$0.85-2.29 per target across sources. Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises connect selected statements to computational skills, illustrated by a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression. FARMS therefore supports an affordable, reusable knowledge foundation for trustworthy automated computational science.

</details>


### [155] [Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40563)
*Eric Rudolph,Philipp Steigerwald,Jens Albrecht*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较了大语言模型（Mistral Mixtral 8x7b，4-bit量化）模拟的咨询来访者与人类扮演者在教育性角色扮演中的表现，并从句子层面分析新手咨询师的沟通模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM能否在教育性角色扮演中真实模拟心理咨询来访者，以及咨询师面对人类与LLM模拟来访者时沟通行为是否存在差异。

Method: 录制新手咨询师与人类同伴（扮演来访者）的角色扮演会话，以及咨询师与LLM模拟来访者（Mistral Mixtral 8x7b，4-bit量化）的角色扮演会话；采用咨询沟通模式编码系统在句子层面分析互动。研究两个问题：(1) LLM生成的回应在多大程度上复现真实对话动态；(2) 咨询师面对人类与LLM模拟来访者时的沟通行为是否不同。

Result: 结果显示，不同情境下咨询模式的应用既存在相似性也存在差异，表明LLM角色扮演在模拟来访者方面具有一定真实性与局限。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的角色扮演练习具有提升咨询胜任力的潜力，同时也指出了虚拟来访者模拟中需进一步改进的方向。

Abstract: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

</details>


### [156] [VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40578)
*Qiushi Sun,Da Yu,Alexander Knop,Amer Sinha,Lingpeng Kong,Ben Kao,Ravi Kumar,Pritish Kamath*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VeriCUA：将 CUA 任务完成验证重新定义为"智能体化探索中的动态证据收集与评估"，用统一流程覆盖桌面/移动/Web、在线/离线与不同观测模态，通过任务 rubric + GUI/代码检查互补取证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建与扩展计算机使用智能体（CUA）需要可靠的任务完成验证，用于数据筛选、评测与强化学习。现有自动化方案有两类：用 VLM 直接评判轨迹，或生成程序检查应用状态。二者都只依赖"部分视图"——VLM 评判受限于给定观测，生成程序受限于可访问状态——可能遗漏关键证据，导致完成判断缺乏支撑；且为不同平台与访问设置分别定制验证器会带来额外工程成本。

Method: VeriCUA 是平台无关的验证框架，把验证视为智能体内的动态证据收集与判定：先检查可用上下文以构建任务 rubric，再针对未满足的要求选择 GUI 检查或代码检查，最后按显式证据规则整合两类证据；同一流程统一在线与离线、跨平台与跨观测模态的验证。

Result: 在上述各设置下，与基线相比，VeriCUA 与参考标签的一致性更高；离线场景中困难样本提升最大，在线场景中对虚假"已完成"声明的拒绝能力更强。进一步分析表明，这些收益来自 GUI 与代码证据的互补性以及测试时探索。

Conclusion: 验证不应依赖单一局部视图，而应作为主动取证过程；一个平台无关、证据驱动的统一验证器可同时改善离线标注质量和在线判定可靠性，降低多平台定制成本。

Abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

</details>


### [157] [Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40588)
*Leonidas Raghav*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 线性探针可在智能体输出前从其激活中预测即将发生的泄密，但大部分增益来自标签监督而非激活本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体共享信道与凭证时，一个智能体可被同伴施压而违背其运营者规则，这是走向串谋的第一步；现有输出过滤器只能检查已生成文本，无法事先预警。

Method: 构建受控多智能体实验：同伴在多轮（至多20轮）内施压目标智能体以套取机密（如部署令牌）。在每个模型调用生成前，对激活做线性探针检测；并与零样本决策模型监控器、同调用上训练的bag-of-words分类器对比；另在gpt-oss-20b的推理轨迹上测试探针。

Result: 在留出的Qwen3-32B回合上，阈值设为误报5%良性调用时，探针捕获82%的泄密调用；同等误报率下零样本监控器仅26%。gpt-oss-20b推理激活探针AUROC达0.91。bag-of-words分类器表现接近，说明增益主要来自标签训练而非激活。探针也会标记被允许的披露，且更偏向读取"即将披露"而非"违规"；预警作用距离短，任警即停会中断多数良性回合，二次文本检查无法弥补。

Conclusion: 生成前的预警可让监督者在智能体即将让步前将其制止，从而阻止他人依据其消息行动或招募在群体中扩散；但预警特异性与作用范围有限，需谨慎使用。

Abstract: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in? We show that a linear probe on the agent's activations can, in a controlled multi-agent setting. Across six scenarios, a peer presses a target for up to 20 rounds to reveal a secret, such as a deploy token; the target often refuses, then gives in. Read at each model call before its output is written, the probe picks out the one that leaks. On held-out Qwen3-32B episodes, at a threshold set to flag 5% of benign calls, it catches 82% of leaking calls. At a similar flag rate, a zero-shot decision-model monitor catches 26%. On gpt-oss-20b, a probe on its reasoning reaches AUROC 0.91. A bag-of-words classifier trained on the same calls comes close, so most of the gain comes from training on labels, not activations. The probe also flags permitted disclosures: it reads the coming disclosure more than the violation. The warning is short-range, and halting on any alarm would stop most benign episodes, which a second text check does not fix. A warning raised before generation could let an overseer stop an agent that is about to give in, ahead of others acting on its messages or recruitment spreading through a swarm.

</details>


### [158] [Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40589)
*El Mustapha Mansouri,Eikichi Kimura,Masato Koga,Keigo Arai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个由大语言模型智能体组成的自主研究实验室，智能体可相互评审、终止或重定向研究；以金刚石量子自旋系综为对象，端到端完成从选题、理论推导到实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统虽能承担部分研究角色，但可能得出证据无法支持的结论，缺乏自我审查与纠错机制；作者希望构建能相互评估并主动停止/调整方向的自主研究实验室。

Method: 基于大语言模型的智能体协作框架：智能体相互评估彼此工作，可生成并否决研究问题、要求独立的理​​论检验、设计用于挑战自身结论的实验；在金刚石量子自旋系综中，推导预测给定微波脉冲序列族响应的最少校准参数数目，进行数值计算验证，并设计区分竞争预测的实验。

Result: 首轮实验与理论预测一致，但重复参考测量显示数据采集期间信号漂移，智能体据此判定结果不确定，并在不放宽验收标准的前提下修订测量协议；修订后实验满足标准并支持理论预测。

Conclusion: 协作式AI智能体能够选择研究问题、推导理论结果并通过实验检验其预测，展示了自主研究实验室的可行性。

Abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [159] [Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37712)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MGO-SC 通过符号指数滑动平均（EMA）的幅度构造逐坐标一致性门控，并给出保持均值的变体以在不降低有效步长的前提下重新分配信任权重；在 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 上于匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减下于干净、对称与非对称标签噪声中稳定优于 AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应优化器在高随机性与标签噪声下（梯度符号与幅度不稳定）性能会退化，现有方法多依赖二阶信息或逐样本过滤，代价较高。

Method: 提出 MGO-SC：对 Adam 类方法的轻量改造，用符号 EMA 的幅度生成逐坐标一致性门控——符号稳定的坐标被信任，符号波动的坐标被降权。指出朴素门控只能收缩更新、损失有效步长，因而引入均值保持（mean-preserving）变体，在坐标间重分配信任而不改变每张量的净步长量级。

Result: CIFAR-10 + ResNet-18，匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减下，均值保持版 MGO-SC 在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声中均一致优于 AdamW 基线（如 40% 对称噪声下 +1.4 点；配对 bootstrap 95% CI 不含零；Wilcoxon p<0.01），且不引入二阶信息或逐样本过滤。报告了匹配种子效应量、非参数 bootstrap 置信区间与配对显著性检验。

Conclusion: 坐标级符号一致性可作为提升 Adam 类优化器抗噪性的有效信号，关键在于采用均值保持的门控形式以维持有效步长；该方法轻量、无需额外开销，并已开源代码与原始日志。

Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

</details>


### [160] [What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37719)
*Shikhar Shiromani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"杠杆率"（leverage）——一种度量单位权重变化所换取行为改变的精确指标，即用Fisher二次型计算的更新，相比于同规模随机方向在同一checkpoint上的同一量。该指标在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2上跨四个数量级区分预训练、SFT、RL、DPO，并揭示预训练累积的是噪声、bf16无主副本训练冻结坐标、以及DARE损伤的标度律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练仅将权重移动约千分之一范数却剧烈改变行为，而预训练移动三分之一范数却只带来"缓慢漂移"，说明权重变化量本身不能衡量其有效性。作者希望建立一个精确、可复现的度量，量化"每单位权重变化买到什么"，从而比较预训练与各类后训练阶段、以及不同训练精度与配方的影响。

Method: 定义leverage为更新的Fisher二次型（每方向一次前向模式求导即可计算），除以同一checkpoint上同规模随机方向的同一Fisher形式。在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2的发布checkpoint上计算该比值；对比不同训练窗口（30k–1M步）与随机方向；比较bf16无fp32主副本训练与fp32训练的坐标冻结与对角Fisher对齐；推导并验证DARE在保留率p下的损伤律（1-p)/(p·ρ_sign)；并以对照实验（fp32 SFT/DPO轨迹、两次重跑DPO阶段）检验读数可靠性。

Result: Leverage跨四个数量级排序各阶段：预训练窗口在文本上与随机水平相当，SFT约为其5倍，RL-Zero与RLVR为400–1,500倍，DPO达400–23,000倍。预训练的30k–1M步窗口对文本的后果不高于同规模随机方向，符合含噪二次SGD模型预测。bf16无主副本训练冻结36–99%坐标、leverage降低最多7倍，并产生更新幅度与对角Fisher的对齐。DARE损伤律在成功区间内与实测相差两倍以内。fp32的SFT/DPO轨迹随训练推进leverage下降；重跑DPO阶段与发布位移相差1%、leverage相差4%，而朴素配方低5–6倍。

Conclusion: leverage是一个精确、可复现的度量，能跨四个数量级区分预训练与后训练各阶段。主要结论：预训练积累的是（类随机）噪声，而后训练阶段是高效的方向性更新；训练精度（bf16无fp32主副本）显著改变更新的几何结构；DARE的损伤可由符号翻转零假设预测；常规配方会系统性低估真实update的leverage。该工具有助于理解后训练为何以极小位移获得显著行为改变。

Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

</details>


### [161] [Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37726)
*Zeen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对神经偏微分方程发现中的中位数/样本标准差阈值，推导了精确的双信号保留边界与完整向量扰动界，并通过有限诊断区分阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三种失效机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确回归并不意味着支持集选择后能得到正确方程；需要厘清稀疏阈值与支持选择步骤在何种条件下会导致扩散项丢失或错误选元。

Method: 对中位数/样本标准差阈值推导双信号保留边界和完整向量扰动界；在精确对流-扩散库上检验系数恢复与扩散项留存；对40个保存的稀疏状态做真支持重拟合；构造固定顺序阈值岭回归对照；进行条件验证与事后能量合并；在4条未使用解析轨迹上作240次物理残差比较；固定系数、观测点与权重下精确替换学习库与目标以检验行序反转；并测试双损失加权下的Burgers扩散收益判据。

Result: 精确对流-扩散库在系数达数值精度时仍丢失扩散项；真支持重拟合降低扩散误差但未恢复全部导数精度；对照法在60个理想控制中精确恢复支持，但在所有学习状态中多选项；全折正确支持候选被条件验证拒绝，事后能量合并保留其更高最小损失（60/60）；供给支持估计在240次物理残差比较中全面优于未改动的选中方程；精确替换使学习行序在59/60状态下反转；双损失加权在所有预算下均未满足Burgers扩散收益判据。

Conclusion: 这些有限诊断揭示了阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三类机制，但不构成自动纠正、通用恢复或预测稳定性的证据。

Abstract: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

</details>


### [162] [Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37727)
*Ioannis Konstantoulas,Iliana Loi,Kyriakos Sgarbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出原生谓词神经元（Native Predicate Neuron），通过一阶逻辑量化将可微符号推理能力原生嵌入标准网络架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号推理依赖静态架构，难以与深度神经网络及梯度优化集成，需将可微逻辑推理原生化以弥合符号推理与连接主义的鸿沟。

Method: 设计可微逻辑推理神经模块：用单一可训练参数学习在逻辑运算间交替；采用双重性质的定制梯度机制——前向执行硬逻辑运算、反向保持可微性；对输入与选择状态进行量化以逼近连续与非连续函数，解决深度网络难以处理的不连续性。

Result: 在全连接、卷积、循环与 Transformer 架构上于 MNIST、Wikitext 等基准评测：加速收敛、普遍提升精度并降低损失，在单调推理及处理不连续性的任务上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成于标准神经网络以实现模糊逻辑运算，并提供 Keras 与 PyTorch 实现。

Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

</details>


### [163] [A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38269)
*Zhijie Su,Qiaolin He,Zhiping Mao,Shiquan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出混合物理信息全纯神经网络（HPIHNN），将非齐次PDE解分解为特解（谱方法在简单扩展域上计算）与齐次解（仅在边界上训练的PIHNN逼近），从而规避复杂网格划分并保留全纯表示的降维优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息全纯神经网络（PIHNN）通过复解析表示可构造性满足齐次PDE，但其向非齐次问题的推广并非平凡，存在困难。

Method: 基于解的特解与齐次分量分解的混合框架：特解在简单扩展域上用谱方法求解；齐次分量由仅使用修改后边界数据、仅在边界上训练的PIHNN逼近。

Result: 应用于非齐次Poisson、Stokes、双调和、线弹性与Helmholtz方程；涵盖复杂几何、角点奇异性与近不可压情形的数值实验显示方法能准确求解，且在这些测试中通常比标准PINN误差更低、训练时间更短。

Conclusion: 将谱特解与全纯神经网络逼近耦合，为非齐次PDE在复杂域上的求解提供了高效途径。

Abstract: Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks (PIHNNs) exploit complex-analytic representations to satisfy homogeneous PDEs by construction, but their extension to nonhomogeneous problems is nontrivial. We propose a hybrid physics-informed holomorphic neural network (HPIHNN) framework based on a decomposition of the solution into particular and homogeneous components. The particular component is computed by a spectral method on a simple extended domain, while the homogeneous component is approximated by a PIHNN trained only on the boundary with modified boundary data. The resulting formulation avoids meshing complex geometries and retains the dimensionality-reduction advantage of holomorphic representations. The method is applied to nonhomogeneous Poisson, Stokes, biharmonic, linear elasticity, and Helmholtz equations. Numerical experiments covering complex geometries, corner singularities, and nearly incompressible regimes demonstrate that the proposed method accurately resolves the corresponding solutions and, in the considered tests, generally achieves lower errors and shorter training times than standard PINNs. The results indicate that coupling spectral particular solutions with holomorphic neural approximations provides an efficient approach to nonhomogeneous PDEs on complex domains.

</details>


### [164] [Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37733)
*Yaxuan Wu,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究荷兰多井地下水异常预测中的上下文感知选择性迁移学习（CASL），用冻结的无迁移/固定迁移双"父模型"做约束式凸混合，在457口井、13,718个测试窗口（5个种子）上检验固定迁移的风险与选择性学习的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源域预训练（固定迁移）虽能提升平均精度，但在异质井群中对相当比例的井反而造成性能退化，平均指标掩盖了逐井风险，需要一种能按上下文选择是否迁移、并控制风险的方法。

Method: CASL在校准集上学习受约束的上下文混合权重，将冻结的无迁移父模型与固定迁移父模型进行凸混合；对照方法Global Convex Blend仅用每个种子的单一校准拟合权重。任务设定要求9个连续观测的月度输入与精确的3个日历月目标、不做插值；源池为四格maxsim0.60且仅依据Always-TL验证RMSE冻结；共5个预设种子。

Result: 固定迁移使18.38–51.86%的井受损。CASL相对No TL的RMSE低0.424–1.084%，对受损井实现部分挽救97.53–99.50%、完全挽救23.46–43.78%。四种子中Global Convex Blend保护更多井，而CASL在四种子中整体池化RMSE略低。

Conclusion: 二者互不支配；部分挽救可由凸混合结构性产生，因此不能证明上下文机制更优。结果仅支持固定划分下的"精度—风险"权衡，尚不能说明滚动部署下的有效性。

Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

</details>


### [165] [Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39041)
*Jingye Li,Jinglai Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种步长依赖由半线性动力学一阶Duhamel近似规定的算子，将精确线性传播与局部非线性项结合，实现无需跨步长稠密监督的亚观测间隔预测，并给出步长间一致性控制预测偏差及双步长局部可辨识性理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变步长算子学习中，模型在观测步长上的一致并不足以保证其在其他时间分辨率下的预测正确，缺乏对步长依赖的结构性约束与理论保证。

Method: 以半线性动力学的一阶Duhamel近似规定步长依赖：算子=精确线性传播+关于场及其导数的局部非线性函数；基础模型直接作用于状态，潜变量扩展将同一构造用于学习得到的场地；理论上在固定空间分辨率下证明两个步长上的模型一致性可界定指定步长范围内预测差异，并给出两部分组件从两个步长局部可辨识的条件。

Result: 理论上获得跨步长预测误差的控制界与双步长局部可辨识性条件；实验上基础模型在两个合成问题、潜变量扩展在两个真实数据集上均优于多个基线。

Conclusion: 通过物理启发的步长结构化设计，可在稀疏步长监督下获得可靠的变分辨率预测，并支持对学习结构的可解释分析。

Abstract: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.

</details>


### [166] [Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37737)
*Samuel Younger,Tinkle Chugh,George De Ath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PFN 的预测似然在目标长度尺度偏离元训练先验众数时会劣于重拟合 GP，本文提出各向异性信赖域(ATR) 变换，通过每个维度的长度尺度估计与仿射重缩放把目标映射到 PFN 期望的尺度，在不重训练网络、不改变 O(d·N²) 推理代价的前提下改善优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFN 用单次前向传播替代 GP 代理模型在贝叶斯优化中的超参数重拟合，但先验在元训练时被固定。实验表明，当目标函数长度尺度超出 PFN 元训练先验的众数时，PFN 的预测对数似然逐渐落后于重新拟合的 GP，且这一缺陷会传导到优化性能上。

Method: 提出 ATR（Anisotropic Trust Region）变换：用核目标对齐（kernel target alignment）估计每个维度的长度尺度；对输入空间做仿射重缩放，使目标被映射到 PFN 所期望的长度尺度；以锚点为中心的信赖域决定保留哪些观测；整个过程无需重训练网络，PFN 的 O(d·N²) 推理开销保持不变。

Result: 在从 Matérn-3/2 核采样的函数上，ATR 变换在长度尺度范围的两个极端均提升了 PFN 的优化性能。

Conclusion: ATR 变换以低成本（无需重训练、推理代价不变）缓解了 PFN 固定先验与目标长度尺度之间的失配，在 Matérn-3/2 目标上验证了其对优化性能的提升，代码已公开。

Abstract: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

</details>


### [167] [Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39897)
*Ana Čukarska,Maximilian Gollwitzer,Viola Muning Li,Vladyslav Fediukov,Zahra Monfared,Felix Dietrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种数据驱动的随机特征方法，为 gEDMD 等 Galerkin 型方法构建稀疏有效的函数字典，用于从数据学习连续时间 Koopman 生成元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman 形式化通过线性算子表示动力系统，但数值近似中如何选择有效的有限维"字典"（函数空间表示）是实际难点；现有数据无关方法精度受限。

Method: 针对连续时间系统，近似 Koopman 生成元而非 Koopman 算子；构造数据驱动的随机特征字典，用于 gEDMD 等 Galerkin 近似，替代迭代优化求解。

Result: 实验表明该方法在预测与系统分析任务上精度高且快于迭代优化；理论证明向量场近似及轨迹收敛；给出 gEDMD 生成半群的通用收敛判据，并构造反例说明 gEDMD 一般不保持指数有界性。

Conclusion: 所提随机特征表示可高效、可解释且数学稳健地从数据学习连续时间动力学，推进了 Koopman 框架下的数据驱动建模。

Abstract: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research. The Koopman formalism is often used here, because it is a flexible approach that is informative about the system's fundamental properties. The formalism represents dynamical systems through linear operators acting on a suitable function space. A practical difficulty arising in the numerical approximation of Koopman operators is the choice of a ``dictionary'', meaning an effective finite-dimensional representation of the function space. In this paper, we focus on learning dynamical systems in continuous-time, and so we consider numerical approximations of the Koopman generator instead of the Koopman operator. Our main contribution is a data-driven random-feature method to obtain a parsimonious and effective function representation for Galerkin approximation methods such as gEDMD. The representation we construct is data-informed, which allows us to improve upon data-agnostic methods. We empirically demonstrate the suitability of our method for forecasting tasks and system analysis. The numerical experiments show that our approach is accurate, and faster than iterative optimization. Further, we prove convergence of our approximation of the vector field and the resulting trajectories. In addition to the numerical results, we also make theoretical contributions, including a general convergence criterion for the semigroup generated by the gEDMD approximation and a counterexample showing that gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness. With our contribution, we advance the frontier of efficiently learning continuous-time dynamics from data, towards interpretable and mathematically robust modelling based on the Koopman framework.

</details>


### [168] [Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37796)
*Diksha Gupta,Rieke Fruengel,Stefan Heimersheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验"连续流形假设"，发现星期流形实际表现为环形排列的七个离散状态，而非连续环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作假设大语言模型可将某些概念表示为多维流形而非单一方向，并常在解释或操控表征时默认沿流形移动对应概念的连续变化。作者要检验这一"连续流形假设"是否成立。

Method: 以典型的星期流形为研究对象：一是测量沿流形操控时的局部敏感性分布；二是检验流形上七个离散状态之外的空间是否编码其他概念（如一天中的时间、不确定性、自然文本）。

Result: 局部敏感性在七个星期处出现七个极小值，表征与行为之间呈阶梯式映射；中间空间既未被时间、不确定性填充，也未被自然文本占据。因此星期表征更像环形排列的七个离散状态，而非连续环。

Conclusion: 结果挑战了星期流形的连续性解释，并提示需检验其他表征流形上的移动是否对应模型表征与行为的有意义变化。

Abstract: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

</details>


### [169] [Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37819)
*Giovanni dos Santos Franco,Felipe Mahlow,Ellison Fernando Cardoso,José Adenaldo Santos Bittencourt,Felipe Fanchini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文对医学影像分类中的经典与量子分类器进行子群体公平性实证审计，发现量子模型可在总体性能上具竞争力，但仍存在子群体差异；且部分"差异最小"的配置因总体判别力下降而不具临床可接受性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中日益受到关注，但其在子群体感知公平性准则下的行为研究不足。作者不以"QML天然公平"为前提，而是对其进行实证检验。

Method: 在DDI皮肤病变（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）与CheXpert胸片（敏感属性：年龄组）两个场景下，基于ResNet-18嵌入训练SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN。设置基线与三种缓解策略：可微Equalized Odds（EO）正则、梯度反转学习（GRL）及二者组合；并以PanDerm、EVA-X作为外部参照。此外，各缓解策略需对照预设的非劣性边界（相对基线的非劣性）进行检验。

Result: 量子分类器总体性能可具竞争力但仍表现子群体差异。在DDI上，QSVM+GRL+EO表现最佳，在性能/公平权衡上接近PanDerm；QCNN+GRL虽差异最小，但因总体判别力损失而不被临床接受。在CheXpert上，QCNN+GRL总体性能最高但差异增大，EVA-X仍更强。

Conclusion: 公平性效应依赖于模型与数据集，QML需进行实证的子群体感知评估；仅缩小AUC差距不等于临床可接受。所有量子模型均在经典模拟下运行，作者不主张量子优势。

Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

</details>


### [170] [Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37823)
*Han Wang,Jingyuan Bao,Juntao Wu,Saiao Zhou,Yuman Nie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究异步事件流学习系统的"切片不变性"与"连续时间"性质，证明事件更新的两两可交换性等价于顺序无关性与时间连续性的充要条件，据此提出时间介导的非交换（TM）模型类，构造最小TM层（HR相关器的可学习Lipschitz推广）与Clock-Free Event（CFE）层，并在多个事件数据集上显著优于加性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机、脉冲耳蜗等传感器输出异步事件，但现有学习系统通常先把事件分帧/分包，导致输出依赖切片方式。作者希望定义并刻画"真正在事件时刻精确更新、事件间闭式演化"的网络所需额外性质：对同时事件处理顺序无关（i）、对时间戳连续（ii，即使两事件时间交叉）、同时保持对时间顺序的敏感性（iii）。

Method: 对任意非线性事件模型证明：(i)与(ii)分别等价于事件更新的两两可交换性；一旦可交换，全部顺序依赖性来自更新与事件间动力学的非交换性，且随时滞线性消失。由此定义时间介导非交换（TM）模型类并给出分辨率鲁棒性界。构造最小TM层——可学习、可证Lipschitz的Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器推广；证明单一加性层无法一致表示有序成对交互，而三维TM状态可以；证明每个TM层增加两级时间嵌套（加性层为一级）；给出单层高阶构造TM-k及保持三性质不变的堆叠规则。实例化为CFE层（事件数线性复杂度），并给出无拓扑点过程变体及闭式似然，附物理时间威胁模型下的预注册时钟鲁棒性协议。

Result: 理论上建立顺序无关性/时间连续性与更新可交换性的等价刻画，并给出分辨率鲁棒性界与表示能力分离结论。初步开发集实验：TM状态相对相同配置的加性状态在DVS128 Gesture上提升3.5–9.1点，在SHD上提升24.5点，在Speech Commands上提升30.6点。

Conclusion: 切片不变性可由事件更新可交换性精确刻画；TM模型类在理论可控（Lipschitz、闭式、线性复杂度）的前提下，比加性模型具有更强的时间序表达力，并在事件传感任务上带来大幅性能提升。

Abstract: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

</details>


### [171] [Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37828)
*Nicholas Teh,Paul W. Goldberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"面向多个利益相关方的AI系统版本混合（lottery over m alternatives）"问题：每个agent只接受满足其未知半空间约束的混合，目标是最小化拒绝的agent数量。证明该问题APX-hard（即使半空间已知且效用为0/1），并给出m为常数时的多项式精确算法、近阈值条件下的准多项式算法、基于均匀采样的加性/相对保证、以及任意m下的LP多项式方法；同时给出仅查询K个agent时m≥3的下界n−K且可达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI开发者常同时持有多个候选系统版本，可通过A/B式随机路由得到混合部署。各利益相关方（安全团队、监管方、持有私有测试数据的客户）仅在其期望性能（如有害回复率）满足自身标准时接受该混合，而该标准只能通过"该混合是否可接受"的二值隶属查询获知。此前Choo et al. (ICML 2026) 追求所有agent均接受的lottery，但当安全与有用性要求冲突时可能不存在可行解，故本文转向最小化拒绝者数量这一更现实的目标。

Method: 形式化为在m个备选上选择lottery、对n个agent进行优化，每个agent的可接受集合为未知半空间，反馈为二值隶属查询。先做计算复杂性分析（归约证明APX-hard）；再设计精确算法：m为常数时多项式时间，存在某最优lottery使所有接受agent距阈值至少η（η为常数）时准多项式时间；对只能查询部分agent的情形，采用agent均匀采样给出与n无关样本量的加性及相对保证，并给出适用于任意m的多项式时间LP方法；最后分析确定性查询K个agent的下界并构造可达算法，辅以合成实验。

Result: 问题即使半空间全部已知且效用均为0/1也是APX-hard。精确算法方面：m为常数时多项式可解；在η-间隔条件下准多项式可解。采样优化对总体给出加性保证和相对保证，样本量不依赖n；LP给出任意m下的多项式时间方法。查询受限时，m≥3下任何仅查询K个不同agent的确定性算法无法保证少于n−K个额外拒绝，且该界可达——即对未查询agent无法提供任何保证。合成实验表明最坏情况界在随机实例上偏保守。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了多利益相关方约束下混合部署选择问题的可解性边界：一般情形APX-hard，但在m常数、近阈值间隔、采样近似等条件下可获得多项式或准多项式算法与统计保证；部分查询场景存在本质性下界（n−K）。实验提示实践中性能优于最坏情况分析，未来方向包括超越二值查询的反馈模型与更紧的近似界。

Abstract: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $η$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $η$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.

</details>


### [172] [Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37833)
*Chen Feng,Tianyi Xu,Ramchalam Kinattinkara Ramakrishnan,Yicheng Lin,Shaojie Zhuo,Zhaocong Yuan,Chenzheng Su,Xiaopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出块循环（block-recurrent）ASR架构，用少量权重共享的循环块替代参数化深度，在保持有效深度的同时将参数量降低一个数量级，两个共享块即可平均恢复大模型97.4%的准确率，并支持端侧高效个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代ASR依靠加深模型与扩大容量获得高精度，但带来内存、能耗与算力负担，在手表、眼镜等资源极度受限的边缘设备上难以部署。作者由此提出核心问题：能否在不扩大参数规模的前提下获得深层ASR模型的高表征能力。

Method: 1) 重新审视深度的作用，发现"层级表征动态"现象：大多数层学习的是功能相似的变换；2) 据此设计块循环架构，用一小组循环块替代参数化深度，每个块由权重共享的层组成，从而在保留有效深度的同时大幅压缩模型；3) 采用表征引导的分组（representation-guided grouping）与知识蒸馏进行训练；4) 在紧凑主干上使用轻量级MoE-LoRA实现设备端个性化适配。

Result: 在Open ASR Leaderboard基准上，仅含两个共享块的模型平均恢复大模型97.4%的准确率，而参数量少一个数量级；结合MoE-LoRA的个性化模型可匹配甚至超越通用ASR系统，且推理成本显著更低；跨循环步复用权重降低了内存访问开销与推理能耗。

Conclusion: 高质量ASR无需大规模参数化即可实现；结构化循环为边缘端超压缩、高能效且可个性化的语音识别提供了一条有原则的路径。

Abstract: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.

</details>


### [173] [Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37842)
*Ethan Baron,Shmuel Berman,Anirudh Satheesh,Akshay Vegesna,Samip Dahal,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文针对数据受限场景下的大模型缩放，指出既有配方固定超参数、忽略集成，可能使损失随算力增加而上升；提出随规模迁移超参数的幂律与含集成的算力分配缩放律，在FineWeb 100M token上验证损失降0.15 nats，困惑度降14%，并实现随算力单调改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算力预算增长快于高质量训练数据增长，模型需在算力与数据双重约束下训练。现有数据受限缩放配方有两大缺陷：一是将权重衰减等关键超参数随规模固定，而最优超参数随模型规模和训练轮数显著变化；二是忽略集成这一数据受限下有效的缩放维度。其结果是既有配方可能导致损失随算力预算增加而上升。

Method: 同时解决上述两方面缺陷：一是拟合幂律来描述超参数随规模迁移的规律；二是构建含集成的缩放律来指导算力分配。实验基于FineWeb的100M token，配方由较小规模运行拟合，并在最大12倍算力预算下验证。

Result: 相比既有配方，验证损失降低超过0.15 nats，困惑度相对下降14%；通过集成实现随算力增加的单调改善；且在至多12倍更大算力预算上得到验证。

Conclusion: 在数据受限缩放中，必须显式建模超参数随规模的迁移并纳入集成维度，才能保证算力投入带来单调收益，避免损失随算力反升的退化现象。

Abstract: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.

</details>


### [174] [Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37880)
*Philip Jacobson,Prasad Iyer,Remi Dingreville,Saaketh Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 nn-EQL 方程学习框架，通过迭代训练-剪枝-重训练带有可定制神经元级激活函数的神经网络生成候选方程，并用受 MDL 启发的评分进行稀疏性与误差平衡的排序与诊断，在高维稀疏材料数据上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方程学习方法多在高维稀疏的材料数据集上难以发现并解释所学方程，缺乏可解释、可诊断的完整工作流。

Method: 使用含用户自定义神经元级激活函数的神经网络，反复执行训练、剪枝、重训练以生成候选方程；以受最小描述长度（MDL）启发的评分函数在误差与稀疏性间权衡排序；并对结果进行逐项贡献、输入缩放敏感性与不确定性诊断；通过标准编码器接入表格与高维数据。

Result: 在 AI-Feynman 标准基准测试，以及多尺度高维材料数据集（异质材料有限元模拟、高通量薄膜沉积实验数据）上演示了框架能力，可学习方程并给出各项解释。

Conclusion: nn-EQL 为稀疏高维材料数据提供可解释方程学习工作流；未来可结合物理可解释表征、多模态与多保真数据及自适应数据采集，以支持机理假设的构建与检验。

Abstract: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

</details>


### [175] [SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37898)
*Muhammad Ifte khairul Islam,Tanvir Hossain,Esra Akbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAC-GCL，用结构分解与图压缩替代随机扰动生成视图，通过黏聚子图抽取与超节点粗化构造多分辨率、结构感知的对比视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GCL依赖边扰动、节点掩码等随机增强，缺乏结构感知，易破坏关键拓扑或引入语义不一致视图；近期自适应方法仅在局部节点/边邻域操作，无法捕捉图分类所需的高阶宏观结构组织。

Method: SAC-GCL框架：利用多种黏聚子图模型（cohesive subgraph models）进行结构分解，提取稠密子图并凝聚为超节点，构建保留局部密度、降低噪声冗余的粗化图视图；采用层次化视图编码器，以共享权重的黏聚子图嵌入初始化超节点特征，实现多分辨率信息编码；多种子图模型产生互补视图。

Result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，结构感知压缩相较于随机扰动具有更强替代性，为图分类任务生成更鲁棒、更具判别力的图表示。

Conclusion: 结构感知压缩是一种有原则的视图生成策略，可有效替代随机扰动，为图对比学习提供结构一致、多分辨率的增强范式。

Abstract: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.

</details>


### [176] [Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37903)
*Giulianno Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: A solo researcher builds two hybrid Mamba-2/attention MoE LMs on 1.02T tokens each; Logos reaches competitive average scores at ~1/12 the median disclosed training data and fewer active params per token, while the report's main value is a candid account of training failures.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Test whether better data, training methods, and architectures can substitute for a larger parameter count at a fraction of the cost, without aiming to challenge frontier models.

Method: Build two from-scratch LMs: Praxis (2.94B total, 0.46B active) and Logos (10.23B total, 1.18B active), using a hybrid Mamba-2 + attention MoE stack looped twice per token. Train each on 1.02T tokens: 804.76B pretraining, 18B context extension to 131,072 tokens, 200B SFT. Also report 10B-token ablations for MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

Result: Across 40 post-trained benchmarks, Logos averages 52.93 (7th of 17, within 1 point of Qwen3-4B), using roughly 1/12 the median disclosed training data and fewer active params per token than any model that beats it, placing it on the Pareto frontier for both. In math it ranks 2nd of 30, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following, and long context.

Conclusion: Pareto-efficient training is achievable, but the paper's key contribution is documenting failures: the configured optimizer never ran (attention trained with AdamW throughout pretraining), a 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off, five fine-tuning choices cost capability, and a length reward under group-mean normalization inverted sign once group pass rate exceeded 2/3 (proven and fixed by a one-line clamp).

Abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

</details>


### [177] [TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37909)
*Mohammad Kazemi,Julie A. McCann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TERRA是一个面向分布式火灾监测的边缘AI框架，结合任务导向本地推理、无身份区域标签上报和置换不变的区域证据聚合，用6比特或24比特负载即达到AUPRC约0.99、MDR 1.81%（FAR≤1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式火灾监测系统常由大量传感设备经共享上行链路报告，但其运行目标往往是识别存在火灾证据的区域，而非恢复各设备的具体测量值；因此传统逐设备数据回传方式在带宽与冗余上并不经济。

Method: 提出TERRA框架，包含任务导向本地推理、去除设备身份的区域标签上报、置换不变的区域证据聚合。设两种上报模式：TERRA-Score传输量化后的本地火灾概率；TERRA-Feature传输紧凑学习表征，接收端用置换不变的DeepSets模型聚合。以分布式室内EN54火灾报警数据集全部15种数值传感模态为概念验证平台，在重复不相交的三折交叉验证下评估区域级火情推断，并考察表征尺寸、任务负载量化、上报可用性以及对漏收与虚假消息的鲁棒性。

Result: 在9条上报且消息完美恢复时，TERRA-Feature以24比特任务负载取得平均AUPRC 0.990；TERRA-Score仅用6比特即达0.987；两者在FAR≤1%时MDR均为1.81%。可靠恢复条件下TERRA-Feature的AUPRC略高，而更紧凑的TERRA-Score对虚假消息污染的敏感性更低。

Conclusion: 面向区域级火灾证据识别的任务导向、无身份上报与置换不变聚合可显著压缩上行负载，且两种模式在精度与鲁棒性上各有优势，可按链路可靠性与带宽约束灵活选择。

Abstract: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation.
