Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究稠密decoder-only Transformer中"循环复用权重"的权衡，发现在固定参数预算下循环整个Transformer质量最强，而在训练FLOPs受限时循环中间层块回报更高；并提出现有循环的增益会饱和、反转或不稳定，可通过循环专属低秩适配器缓解，同时修正Parallel Loop Transformer以保留质量增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环（looping）复用同一Transformer或其部分权重，可在不增加参数量的前提下加深模型，但其价值取决于主导约束是模型规模、训练算力还是自回归推理效率。作者希望在统一实验中联合刻画这三类约束下的取舍，回答"循环是否有用、怎么循环、如何传递信息"等设计问题。

Method: 从头训练稠密decoder-only Transformer，控制变量包括：被循环的模块（整个Transformer vs 中间层块）、循环次数（最多32次）、循环间信息传递方式；规模达1B参数、155B token、1.07e21 FLOPs。进一步引入循环专属低秩适配器（loop-specific LoRA），并分析Parallel Loop Transformer（在相邻token位置间传递隐状态以实现循环阶段并行）的质量保持问题，提出保留当前token embedding并对其与前一token隐状态分别归一化后再融合的改进。

Result: ①固定参数预算下，循环整个Transformer质量最强；训练FLOPs受限时，循环中间层块回报更优。②加循环并非单调有益，增益会饱和、反转或变得不稳定。③循环专属低秩适配器可提升质量，且循环越多增益越大（说明强制所有循环共享同一权重限制了深层循环的收益）。④标准循环解码存在与循环次数成正比的减速；原版Parallel Loop Transformer不能稳定保留普通循环的质量增益，而所提归一化+保留当前token embedding的修正方案在各模型规模与训练预算下恢复了强性能。

Conclusion: 有效的循环设计必须与资源约束（参数、训练算力）和推理场景（自回归解码效率）相匹配：追求参数效率应循环整个Transformer，算力受限应循环中间块；要突破共享权重的瓶颈需引入循环专属适配器；要在并行解码下保持质量则需修正隐状态传递与归一化方式。

Abstract: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unstable. This motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. We address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality, with larger gains as more loops are added. Looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. Parallel Loop Transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions, allowing loop stages to run concurrently. However, in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. We find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. Together, these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

</details>


### [350] [Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40328)
*Xinhe Zhang,Arnau Marin-Llobet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 语言模型在同一隐藏状态中并行编码多个独立演化的上下文计时变量（语言切换计时与主题变化计时），二者表现为近似可分解：各自可线性解码、各自位于可选择性访问的质心平面内，联合状态几何近似可加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作刻画了单个时间或上下文量的结构化表征，但对多个独立上下文变量在表征空间中如何"联合组织"（是否共享子空间、是否相互干扰、几何是否可加）缺乏理解。

Method: 构造受控文档，设置相位独立的语言切换计时器与主题变化计时器；在十个预训练检查点（含Qwen3 0.6B–14B）上做线性探针解码、质心平面消融（移除某一计时器对应的质心平面）、跨计时器信息交叉分析，并比较计时值数量（3–51个）与联合状态质心的可复现变异来源。

Result: 两个计时器均可从同一隐藏状态线性解码；移除某一计时器的质心平面对其对应变量的可访问性影响显著，而对同时存在的另一计时器影响很小；两平面非正交且互含跨计时器信息；各自单独的计时器贡献可解释联合质心间大部分可复现变异；消融位移未见一致的计时器特异性输出效应，但调度位置会影响续写概率。

Conclusion: 结果支持"基于选择性可访问性的近似因子分解"与"重叠子空间中近似可加的联合状态几何"，即多上下文变量以部分共享、部分分离的子空间组织，而非严格正交或完全纠缠。

Abstract: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.

</details>


### [351] [A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40345)
*Mads Toftrup,Marco Federici,Boris van Breugel,Paul Whatmough,Markus Nagel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对低比特量化中量化范围、线性变换与权值舍入被分别用局部重构目标独立优化、忽视量化误差对下游预测影响各异的问题，基于Hessian/ Fisher近似推导出权值与激活联合量化引起输出变化的近似，并据此构建统一的训练后量化框架，在同一输出敏感目标下联合优化这三个组件，在通道级与块级量化下均优于现有变换与舍入方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化可在降低显存与计算开销的同时实现大模型高效部署，但低精度下保持高精度需要合理选择量化范围、线性变换与权值舍入。现有方法通常以局部重构目标分别独立优化这些组件，无法刻画量化误差对下游预测的不同影响；直接优化任务级指标虽更忠实，却因量化操作的不可微性与评估下游影响的高计算代价而难以实现。

Method: 推导权值与激活联合量化所引起输出变化的Hessian引导近似；基于可处理的Fisher近似，构建统一的训练后量化框架，在共同的输出敏感目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换与权值舍入。

Result: 所得方法对现代大语言模型仍具实用性，并在通道级与块级量化设置下一致优于当前最先进的变换方法与舍入方法。

Conclusion: 以输出敏感度作为统一目标、联合优化量化范围、线性变换与权值舍入，可在保持实用性的同时提升低比特量化的下游精度，优于分开独立优化的局部重构范式。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects.
  In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. Based on a tractable Fisher approximation, we formulate a unified post-training quantization framework that enables the joint optimization of quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective. The resulting method remains practical for modern large language models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods across both channel-wise and block-wise quantization settings.

</details>


### [352] [Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40362)
*Qifan Yu,Xinyu Ma,Xingyan Bin,Di He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出权重归一化(WN)相对权重衰减(WD)的预训练收益主要源于其诱导的有效学习率(ELR)轨迹，进而提出以ELR为调度对象的新调度器AIR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明WN相比WD能带来显著的预训练损失收益，但收益来源不明；同时传统LR调度设计以名义学习率为对象，缺乏理论依据。作者希望厘清WN收益的真正机制，并据此重新定义调度设计的目标变量。

Method: 通过匹配ELR轨迹的对照实验，验证WN与WD的训练损失动态主要由ELR决定；据此提出AIR调度（仿射逆平方根衰减），将以理论推导的1/√t衰减为基础，配合仿射调整，在有限训练期限内满足指定的峰值与终端LR。并识别出后期ELR调度是增益关键来源，因共享的后期调度会削弱早期LR选择的影响。在128B token的MoE预训练上进行验证，并将同一ELR轨迹施加于WD以检验泛化性。

Result: AIR在训练损失、下游性能和超参数鲁棒性上均优于余弦等候选调度；在累计LR匹配条件下，终端训练损失较余弦降低约0.01。将相同ELR轨迹用于WD可复现对应的训练动态。

Conclusion: WN的收益本质来自ELR轨迹而非归一化本身；ELR应作为有原则的调度对象，调度设计应瞄准ELR而非名义LR；AIR是一致有效的具体实现，且其收益不局限于固定范数训练。

Abstract: Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We show that these gains are driven primarily by the induced effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory rather than by normalization alone. Matching ELR trajectories largely collapses the training loss dynamics of WN and WD. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR) alone. Building on this principle, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay), which combines a theoretically derived $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay with an affine adjustment to satisfy prescribed peak and terminal LRs over a finite training horizon. We further identify late-stage ELR scheduling as a key source of its gains, because a shared late schedule attenuates the effect of earlier LR choices. Experiments on 128 B-token Mixture-of-Experts pretraining demonstrate that AIR outperforms cosine and other candidate schedules in training loss, downstream performance, and hyperparameter robustness, reducing terminal training loss by approximately 0.01 relative to cosine at matched cumulative LR. Applying the same ELR trajectory to WD reproduces the corresponding training dynamics, showing that the benefits extend beyond fixed-norm training and establishing ELR as the principled scheduling object.

</details>


### [353] [Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40364)
*Jakub Gilewicz,Dominik Galus,Piotr Wojdas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个统一基准，在MuJoCo MJX的五个3D四足机器人上以相同协议比较14种无监督环境设计（UED）、域随机化和机器人课程学习方法，并用分层自助法区间与逐关卡支配比较给出鲁棒排名，发现不存在在所有机器人和关卡集上都处于最优组的课程方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UED方法（PLR、ACCEL、SFL、PAIRED）主要在2D迷宫、网格世界和BipedalWalker上比较，而足式机器人地形课程多为手工设计、仅有少量基线对照，缺乏跨机器人、统一协议、统计严谨的系统性评测。

Method: 提出统一基准：关卡为8维可解释地形参数向量；14种方法驱动同一PPO学生网络并在匹配的环境步预算下训练；覆盖闭链W01-TEK与开链Unitree Go1、Go2、Google Barkour vB、Boston Dynamics Spot五台3D四足机器人；评估包括随机与留出结构化地形上的成功率、四分位均值配分层自助法区间、能力包络以及逐关卡支配比较，并对每组关卡集给出与最优方法无显著差异的"最优组"。

Result: 无任何方法在所有机器人、所有关卡集上均进入最优组。含易/低难度训练关卡的方法（无论是否经过筛选）在Go1、Barkour的分布内随机关卡以及W01-TEK（PAIRED+BiBC除外）上占据最优组；来自足式实践的成功驱动地形课程进入最优组最频繁；均匀关卡上的域随机化从未进入最优组；PAIRED仅在Spot上进入最优组，此时14种方法在难度0.25随机关卡上仅相差3.8个百分点。三台机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者并非留出地形上的领先者。

Conclusion: 课程学习方法的优劣高度依赖机器人平台与关卡集，单一基准上的结论难以迁移；分布内随机关卡表现无法可靠预测留出结构化地形上的泛化能力。作者将结果整理为按机器人选择课程的实用指南。

Abstract: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

</details>


### [354] [Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40383)
*Wael Mattar,Daniel Freedman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出广义Feynman-Kac校正器（GFKC），可从多个预训练扩散模型的任意目标函数组合中正确采样，并支持奖励引导，无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用需要从多个预训练模型组合（并可能向下游奖励高值倾斜）所定义的分布中采样，而非单一预训练模型的分布。直接叠加各模型分数会产生错误样本，而现有校正方法仅适用于特定目标族。

Method: 证明任意初始函数与模型目标函数之间的几何插值满足Feynman-Kac偏微分方程，并推导其势函数的闭式解；推广对数概率ODE，在由不同速度场驱动的轨迹上追踪各模型的密度，从而在生成过程中在线评估该势函数。算法完全在对数域运算，可无额外概念成本地融入奖励引导，并在生成时即时校正，无需重训练或微调。

Result: 在解析高斯模型上与真实目标高度吻合；在MNIST训练的扩散模型上，可从模型的非平凡组合中采样，并实现有效的引导控制。

Conclusion: GFKC为多预训练扩散模型组合及奖励倾斜分布的采样提供了原理性、通用且免训练的框架。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

</details>


### [355] [SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40407)
*Zhenghong Ke,Jingbo Zhou,Hua Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCARL 通过用"置信度-结果对齐差距"重加权优势值，使同一优势样本被驱动至相同置信度，缓解 RLVR 中序列置信度与奖励错位及熵坍缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 用规则验证器给采样回复打分并强化通过者，但策略对某回复的置信度与其奖励之间缺乏约束：训练并未像分类器那样把预测概率与标签耦合。由此产生"序列-置信度错位"——几乎靠运气找到的成功与近乎确定得到的成功获得相同更新，高置信错误与探索性错误被同等纠正，导致探索效率低下与熵坍缩。

Method: 提出 SCARL：对每个优势值按"响应组内相对置信度"与该优势所认证结果之间的对齐差距进行重塑（reshape，而非重新赋号 re-sign），并归一化为各类别优势预算的份额；错位样本吸收更多更新力度，同优势响应被推向等置信度。该方法在类内置信度一致时可证明退化为原始估计器，不增加额外前向/反向计算，仅增加一个超参数。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，平均 Pass@32 较 DAPO 提升 2.4 个点；在九个等算力匹配方法中，覆盖率与单次采样准确率均最优。在四种估计器与四种骨干网络上不做改动直接应用，16 组设置中 14 组得到改善，同时保持策略熵并扩大置信度-正确性分离度。

Conclusion: 置信度-结果错位是 RLVR 中被忽视的结构性缺陷，通过优势重加权可同时提升推理性能与探索保持能力；SCARL 通用、轻量、可即插即用于现有估计器与模型。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at https://github.com/kezhh163/scarl.

</details>


### [356] [IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40418)
*Anushka Katiyar,Cong Feng,Jing Wang,Tristan Liu,Simon Julien,Zachary Jacobs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息多模态深度学习框架，实现10–110分钟光伏功率概率预测，FSS达0.2950，优于14个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向10–110分钟中短期光伏功率概率预测，需同时刻画电站时序历史、逆变器级空间云动态与太阳几何等物理先验，并解决长时程预测不确定性与预测漂移问题。

Method: 四分支架构：图注意力编码器（学习邻接矩阵）编码逆变器级空间云动态，另设电站级时序历史分支、已知未来太阳几何分支与当前气象状态分支；经门控交叉注意力融合。几何分支引入前向物理信号（空间云异质性与逆变器降载活动），按预测时程加权。解码器以智能持续性基线为锚，学习时程条件修正；分位数预测经核加权自适应保形校准在线校准。

Result: FSS 0.2950，比次优模型高0.099；分支消融显示各分支均正贡献；阴天与多变量天空条件下仍保持FSS 0.198与0.255。

Conclusion: 物理信息与多模态融合结合基线锚定修正及在线保形校准，可显著提升中短期光伏概率预测技能，并在恶劣天空条件下保持稳健性。

Abstract: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).

</details>


### [357] [NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40420)
*Chenyang Wang,Jiawei Theresa Tang,Xinran Liu,Xinyu Lu,Xulei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出模型无关的NECA方法，通过检索早期窗口相似的训练集患者，将其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转化为6/12/24/42h累积事件曲线特征，与原始表征拼接后供下游预测器使用，在PhysioNet 2012与MIMIC-IV子集上稳定提升多器官、多horizon预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICU早期记录存在测量不规则、变量异质、需跨多个未来horizon预测器官特异性风险等难点；现有监督模型将患者视为孤立样本，未显式利用相似历史患者已观测到的事件时序信息。

Method: NECA（Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation）：基于早期窗口画像检索相似的训练集患者，将其后续器官功能障碍事件起始时间转换为6h、12h、24h、42h的累积事件曲线特征；特征与原始患者表征拼接，交由标准下游预测器，方法本身与模型无关。

Result: 在PhysioNet 2012与4,000条住院记录的MIMIC-IV子集上，覆盖四类器官功能障碍事件任务与七种监督学习器，平均PR-AUC与ROC-AUC均提升；神经功能障碍增益最大，PhysioNet 2012上任务级平均PR-AUC由0.461升至0.557。消融显示临床有意义的检索与horizon特异性邻居风险贡献主要增益，完整累积曲线提供任务相关的时序上下文。

Conclusion: 相似患者的事件时序可作为结构化的时间风险信号，有效支持ICU器官功能障碍早期预测；代码将在论文录用后公开。

Abstract: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

</details>


### [358] [Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40421)
*Aleksandr Dekhovich,Carlas Smith,Oleg Soloviev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出不确定性感知反馈循环诊断(UFLD)，用强化学习自适应采集测量并用保形预测确定最优停止时刻，减少约40%采集时间且达98.4%检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体制造中晶圆图缺陷检测需高精度低成本；现有深度学习需全表面扫描，阻碍高通量检测系统发展。

Method: UFLD：强化学习驱动的自适应测量采集，每步输出预测不确定性，信息充分即停止；采用参数高效的保形预测框架确定最优停止时间，无需集成模型或额外置信度估计网络。

Result: 在MixedWM38数据集上，采集时间减少约40%，检测精度达98.4%；优于现有自适应采集流程与标准CNN。

Conclusion: UFLD为高通量晶圆缺陷检测提供高效、无需额外置信度网络的方案，兼顾精度与成本。

Abstract: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.

</details>


### [359] [A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40437)
*Ke Fan,Wen Wu,Haitao Su,Yilin Wang,Yuan Zhou,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个预训练贝叶斯滤波基础模型FilterFM，用单一checkpoint实现异构动力系统的状态估计，并首次实现零样本滤波。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有状态估计要么依赖需已知动力学的在线贝叶斯滤波，要么需针对单一系统或参数族从头训练的神经滤波器；核心障碍是结构性异构——不同动力系统在动力学、物理尺度与噪声水平上差异大，难以共享表征空间，缺乏可复用的滤波器。

Method: FilterFM采用层级式两级观测序列编码器，以及先验到后验的状态重构模块，以适配异构系统间不同的观测与状态维度；通过分位数预测建模状态不确定性；在异构滤波任务混合数据上预训练。

Result: 域内性能优越，相比现有基线在估计精度、运行效率与噪声鲁棒性上显著提升；首次成功实现未见动力学上的零样本滤波；并观察到基础模型式贝叶斯滤波的清晰scaling行为，消融研究验证了设计的结构最优性。

Conclusion: FilterFM以单一预训练模型统一异构系统滤波，弥合状态估计的泛化鸿沟，揭示scaling规律并拓展该方向的研究边界。

Abstract: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. Beyond in-domain performance, it marks the first model to successfully enable zero-shot filtering on unseen dynamics, bridging the generalization gap in state estimation. Furthermore, we uncover clear scaling behaviors in foundation-model-based Bayesian filtering, which combined with comprehensive component ablation studies, validate the structural optimality of our design and broaden the generalization scope for this research field.

</details>


### [360] [Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40443)
*Maya M. Martirossyan,Hillary Pan,Philipp Höllmer,Stefano Martiniani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OMatG-FC框架条件生成方法，在固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量的条件下，用离散流匹配生成原子种类、随机插值生成晶胞体积缩放，实现无机晶体材料的约束式从头生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料生成的终极目标是获得稳定、唯一、新颖（S.U.N.）结构，但现有方法要么受限于数据挖掘式的离子替换，要么受限于无约束从头生成的高维难题；而实际预测出的S.U.N.结构往往只是新化学组分映射到已知结构原型/框架上，因此可显式利用这一启发式先验来降低生成难度。

Method: 以结构框架（晶胞形状与各粒子分数坐标）为条件约束：固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量，仅对原子种类采用离散流匹配（discrete flow matching），对晶胞晶格的体积缩放采用随机插值（stochastic interpolants）；相比无框架生成显著降低问题维度，且比原型约束方法更灵活。同时对MP-20数据集的唯一框架数量进行统计，揭示框架重复现象并提供框架划分（framework-split）版本；在LeMat-GenBench基准上以三种机器学习原子间势评估。

Result: 在LeMat-GenBench上取得凸包以下（below the convex hull）的S.U.N.率最优（state-of-the-art），并能发现由已知结构框架衍生的、此前未见且稳定的新原型；MP-20统计显示数据集内存在大量重复框架。

Conclusion: 无需学习原子堆积（atomic packing），仅以框架为条件即可高效生成稳定、唯一、新颖的晶体材料；框架条件化是一种灵活且有前景的从头生成范式，同时提示数据集框架重复问题需要框架划分式评估。

Abstract: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

</details>


### [361] [Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40449)
*Nicolò Botteghi,Matteo Tomasetto,Andrea Manzoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文是一篇综述，统一RL与PDE约束优化的视角，系统梳理无模型、基于模型和多智能体RL用于PDE控制的方法，重点关注样本效率、参数泛化与高维可扩展性，并用混沌系统镇定与流动控制两个实例说明实践中的性能与陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE控制的固有难点——高维状态空间、分布式驱动、非线性动力学与严格实时约束——使传统方法受限；RL因能合成适应工况变化并可实时部署的反馈控制器而成为有前景的范式，但缺乏统一视角与系统评估规范的梳理。

Method: 综述性研究：建立RL与PDE约束优化的统一框架，按无模型、基于模型、多智能体三类方法学进行分类梳理，围绕样本效率、参数变化下的泛化性与高维可扩展性展开分析；辅以混沌系统镇定和流动控制两个示范案例，并讨论评估与基准测试实践。

Result: 归纳了三类RL方法在PDE控制中的适用性与权衡；通过两个案例展示了RL智能体的实际性能及其失效情形（pitfalls）；总结了现有评估与基准测试的不规范之处。

Conclusion: RL为PDE控制提供了可行的反馈合成途径，但在可靠性、数据效率与可扩展性方面仍存在明显局限；需建立规范的评估与基准体系，并指出面向科学计算的可信、数据高效、可扩展RL是未来研究方向。

Abstract: Controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a challenging task in scientific computing, owing to high-dimensional state spaces, distributed actuation, nonlinear dynamics, and stringent real-time constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing feedback controllers that adapt to varying operating conditions and can be deployed efficiently in real-time. This review provides a unified perspective on RL and PDE-constrained optimization, and surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches to PDE control, with particular emphasis on sample efficiency, generalization across parametric variations, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. Two demonstrative examples, the stabilization of a chaotic system and a flow control problem, illustrate the performance and pitfalls of RL agents in practice. Finally, we discuss evaluation and benchmarking practices, current limitations, and open research directions toward reliable, data-efficient, and scalable RL for scientific computing.

</details>


### [362] [Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40468)
*Cynthia Dwork,Andisheh Ghasemi,Lunjia Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“对抗性选择域的域泛化”问题，并刻画其样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据丰富机构训练的预测模型在部署到新人群（如数据稀缺的农村人群）时常失效；希望利用数据丰富医院的通用知识为农村人群构建临床诊断与决策算法。

Method: 建模为对抗性选择域的域泛化：要求学习器在任意未见目标域上的表现接近与观测源域证据一致的最差假设。仅假设假设类存在一个在所有k个源域上误差均小的“通用”预测器，用VC维d刻画样本复杂度，并分析放宽学习目标（与在99%而非100%源域上表现良好的假设竞争）及元分布设置下目标域少量标注数据的影响。

Result: 在目标略作放宽后，样本复杂度由Ω(dk)显著降至O(d)（至对数因子）；用于元分布设置时，相应改进已知样本复杂度上界；目标域少量标注样本不能改善源域上的最坏情形样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 放宽至与覆盖99%源域的优秀假设竞争即可大幅降低样本复杂度，为跨机构、跨人群的临床模型迁移提供理论依据；目标域标注数据对最坏情形样本复杂度无帮助。

Abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains.
  Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

</details>


### [363] [Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40471)
*Tyler King,Magnus Saebo,Jeremie Laydevant,Haoting Zhen,Maxwell G. Anderson,Tatsuhiro Onodera,Peter L. McMahon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过引入模型压缩等现代ML训练实践并结合MLP-Mixer式参数高效架构，基于非线性动力系统的物理神经网络在仿真中可达MNIST 99.2%、CIFAR-10 86.4%（含预训练与知识蒸馏达92.2%）的精度，且暗示推理能效与速度较数字电子神经网络可提升数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOTA ML模型规模与算力需求激增，物理神经网络因潜在高能效被视为有吸引力的加速器；但其现有推理精度远低于常规数字神经网络，需缩小这一精度差距。

Method: 仿真研究：对多种基于非线性动力系统的候选物理神经网络应用现代ML训练实践（含模型压缩）；并将某一动力系统作为核心构建块，设计受MLP-Mixer启发的参数高效架构（另采用预训练与知识蒸馏）；同时对示例物理动力系统做推理能效与速度的数量级估算（back-of-the-envelope）。

Result: MNIST手写数字识别精度最高99.2%；CIFAR-10图像分类最高86.4%（预训练+知识蒸馏后92.2%），而未使用mixer架构时同一系统仅64%；mixer方案在可训练参数量较基线减少5倍以上的情况下取得该精度；能效与速度估算显示较数字电子神经网络有望实现数个数量级提升。

Conclusion: 借助模型压缩等现代训练实践与参数高效架构设计，物理神经网络可显著缩小与数字神经网络的精度差距，并具备大幅超越数字电子神经网络的推理能效与速度潜力（结论基于仿真与粗略估算）。

Abstract: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

</details>


### [364] [Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40483)
*Juan Belieni,Ana Carolina Erthal,Eliezer de Souza da Silva,Diego Mesquita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP)，将每次遗忘更新投影到历史遗忘集激活子空间的正交补上，实现一阶无干扰的持续遗忘，在TOFU与RWKU上兼顾序列效用与遗忘效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中遗忘请求在模型生命周期内持续、序列地发生，但多数LLM遗忘方法面向单次删除设计；顺序遗忘时更新之间相互干扰，新删除会撤销先前删除或沿已退化方向继续推进，导致遗忘与效用急剧衰减。

Method: 梯度投影方案：为每个遗忘集缓存各层激活的秩子空间，将当前梯度步限制在这些历史激活子空间的正交补中；理论上保证与先前删除的一阶无干扰；每层仅存储低秩基，不需保存历史梯度或历史遗忘集；可作为插件套用于基于可微损失的梯度式遗忘方法且不改变其目标函数。

Result: 在TOFU与RWKU基准上，COP在连续请求下保持效用且不削弱遗忘，避免了标准遗忘目标的坍缩，遗忘效果优于持续学习专用基线。

Conclusion: 通过正交投影约束更新方向可有效消除序列遗忘间的干扰，为迭代式LLM遗忘提供低存储、即插即用且理论可证的一阶无干扰方案。

Abstract: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.

</details>


### [365] [The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40485)
*Lngel Kyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将幂律协方差下归一化一阶优化器在高指数 s 处的停滞归因于数值精度墙，并给出临界指数公式 s*_O(V,D)=[log(1/ε_O)-log V]/log(VD)+δ_O，在 16 组配置上预测 Adam 的失效阈值误差在 0.45 以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩矩阵感知中，幂律测量协方差虽保持 Burer–Monteiro 景观无虚假局部极小，但除归一化的一阶优化器会在临界指数 s* 之上停滞，其机理此前未被解释。

Method: 在真值处分析最小非规范期望 Hessian 特征值，得到其主导阶为 V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}；当该曲率低于优化器有效分母下限 ε_O 时，归一化噪声淹没稀有方向梯度，从而推导出临界边界公式，并用 Adam 在四种配置标定 δ_Adam 后冻结，在 V∈{64,128,256,512}×D∈{4,8,16,32} 的留出网格上检验。

Result: 冻结 δ_Adam 后，公式在全部 16 个网格单元内以 0.45 的误差预测 Adam 的失效起点，可区分固定 VD 的配对情形，并能区分分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙；在 D=2 时失效，反映有限 D 谱交叉，且在 ε_0=10^{-8} 以下出现动力学地板饱和。

Conclusion: 归一化一阶优化器的停滞源于分母精度墙而非景观病态；所提标度律具可预测性，但受限于有限 D 谱交叉与小 ε_0 动力学地板。

Abstract: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.

</details>


### [366] [Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40499)
*Kirill Korolev,Artur Goldman,Timofei Gritsaev,Tigran Ramazyan,Nikita Morozov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对有界凸域上的高维积分，提出基于反射动力学的学习式扩散采样器：用反射扩散将目标分布逐步变换为域上的均匀分布并训练神经网络分数模型反向生成提议分布，配合反射扩散的变测度公式得到无额外边界项的训练目标与无偏重要性采样估计；对非光滑被积函数给出基于反射前高斯提议密度的 REINFORCE 梯度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准拟蒙特卡洛不根据被积函数自适应选取采样点，而有效的重要性采样需要一个能刻画目标集中性的提议分布；现有学习式扩散采样器多在 $\mathbb R^d$ 上建模，无法满足 $x\in D$ 的域约束。因此需要在有界凸域内构造"天然"满足约束的提议分布，并保证估计无偏、训练可行。

Method: 1) 用构造上始终停留在 $D$ 内的反射动力学构建提议：反射扩散将目标分布逐步推向 $D$ 上的均匀分布，训练神经分数模型以反向该过程；2) 利用反射扩散的变测度公式，导出无需额外边界项的训练目标，并给出 $Z$ 的无偏重要性采样估计；3) 对重参数化梯度可能无定义或无信息的非光滑被积函数，在反射前的高斯提议密度下推导 REINFORCE 训练梯度估计，无需计算反射转移密度、也无需对 $r$ 求导。

Result: 在大量合成目标与真实问题上进行评估，所提方法表现强劲，并且在问题维度以及蒙特卡洛估计所用样本点数两方面均呈现良好的扩展性。

Conclusion: 以反射动力学为核心的学习式采样器为有界凸域高维积分提供了域约束自然满足、估计无偏且对非光滑被积函数稳健的方案，并在维度与样本量上具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.

</details>


### [367] [Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40544)
*Ibrahim Salifu,Muhaisin Tiyumba Nantogmah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建监督式机器学习流水线，对加纳移动货币（MoMo）诈骗与正常SMS进行分类；经领域特定归一化与TF-IDF特征化后，朴素贝叶斯与线性SVM在留出集上达到1.00的准确率、F1与AUC-ROC，交叉验证平均准确率分别为96.6%、94.9%和92.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoMo已成为加纳主流零售支付渠道（2025年12月交易额达5184亿塞地、活跃账户超2670万），同时通过SMS/USSD实施的社工诈骗激增，诈骗者冒充运营商、代理商、亲属或监管者骗取PIN、身份信息与资金，亟需面向本地语境的短信诈骗检测手段。

Method: 基于220条、覆盖18个诈骗与正常子类的标注语料；先对金额、电话号码、USSD代码做领域特定归一化，再进行一元与二元TF-IDF向量化；采用分层五折交叉验证加20%留出测试集，训练并评估多项式朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM与随机森林，指标含准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、MCC与AUC-ROC。

Result: 留出集上朴素贝叶斯与线性SVM的准确率、F1、AUC均达1.00；交叉验证平均准确率依次为96.6%(±3.3)、94.9%(±4.6)、92.0%(±4.2)。判别性n-gram中，诈骗文本体现命令式紧迫性（"send""claim""please send"）与PIN索取（"PIN""pincode"），正常文本则含确认与警示用语（"balance""successful""do not share"）。

Conclusion: 可解释的经典分类器在结构化MoMo诈骗文本上准确率高，适用于低资源、端侧场景下的运营商或终端级过滤；研究亦讨论了撒哈拉以南非洲SMS诈骗检测背景、小型模板化语料的性能上限效应，以及构建更大规模自然多语言语料的路径。

Abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.

</details>


### [368] [Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40564)
*Yuda Song,Alvin Zhang,Fahim Tajwar,Daman Arora,Jeff Schneider,Daniel Khashabi,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,J. Andrew Bagnell,Aarti Singh,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"统一训练"(unified training)，将预训练、中期训练、SFT与RL各阶段统一为单一基于似然的训练算法，把训练生命周期简化为"选什么数据、以何比例、何时训练"的数据调度问题，传统分阶段训练成为其特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型训练采用分阶段流水线（预训练→中期训练→SFT→RL），数据与学习算法同时切换，这种算法层面的割裂并非本质必要，且带来流程复杂、目标不一致与难以持续学习等问题。作者希望寻找一个统一的数学原则来整合各阶段。

Method: 通过将合适的RL目标推导为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，使所有训练阶段都可归入同一个似然驱动算法；据此把训练生命周期重构为数据选择、配比与时序设计问题，并实现一个统一训练系统，在单一训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成样本。

Result: 在受控实验与真实实验中，统一训练改善了精度—算力权衡并提升任务覆盖度，同时保持更广泛的能力，并为持续学习提供更强的起点。

Conclusion: 该工作为统一的基础模型训练科学奠定基础，将数学原理、训练基础设施与模型能力发展联系起来。

Abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

</details>


### [369] [An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40618)
*Samson Gourevitch,Yazid Janati,Eric Moulines,Eric P. Xing,Alain Durmus,Giacomo Zanella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将连续扩散中的"概率流ODE"思想推广到离散扩散模型，提出指数残余流（ERF），通过为每个token/位置的离散状态附加连续残余变量并使其按分段ODE确定性演化，证明该构造保持原扩散的边缘分布，从而实现确定性采样与一致性蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散模型的边缘分布可由确定性的概率流ODE复现，这为加速采样和一致性蒸馏奠定基础；但离散扩散模型是否存在类似确定性对应形式尚不清楚，作者试图回答这一问题。

Method: 为每个token和位置在离散状态之外增广一个连续残余变量；残余按分段定义的ODE确定性演化，其向量场依赖当前离散状态及指定扩散模型的前向/后向速率矩阵；当某残余变量到达零时离散状态发生跳变。随后给出采样器的实用离散化，并专门化到masked扩散与uniform扩散。

Result: 理论证明该构造保持原扩散模型的边缘分布；给出可实现的离散化采样器并适配masked/uniform扩散；ERF的确定性轨迹支持一致性蒸馏，在代码与文本生成等多项基准上相较已有方法取得经验性提升。

Conclusion: 离散扩散模型同样存在类似概率流ODE的确定性表述（ERF），兼具理论上的边缘保持性与实践上的加速采样、蒸馏收益，为离散扩散的快速高质量生成提供了新框架。

Abstract: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

</details>


### [370] [world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40637)
*Tobias Schmidt,Rodrigo Gonzalez Laiz,Krisztián Szuppinger,Steffen Schneider*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 world2vec，一种仅从观测与动作中（不使用奖励信息）学习"机制性"世界模型的方法，其潜在动力学在长预测时域上忠实复现真实系统，参数量比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 少至少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能取得强控制性能，但其学到的动力学并不忠实于环境真实机制，因而难以用于机制可解释性与科学发现；作者希望弥合"控制有效"与"机制忠实"之间的鸿沟。

Method: world2vec：无奖励监督、直接从观测与动作学习潜在动力学；以长时域预测保真度为核心目标，模型规模显著更小（参数效率高）。

Result: 在从像素输入的连续控制环境中达到 SOTA 性能；在包含 71 个吸引子的基准上实现准确系统辨识；参数量较 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 少至少 10 倍。

Conclusion: 机制忠实的潜在动力学与高效控制可兼得，世界模型可作为科学发现与机制解释的工具。

Abstract: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.

</details>


### [371] [Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40649)
*Nicolas Dufour,Elouan Gardès,Amil Dravid,Patrick Pérez,Loic Landrieu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文重新审视Neural Thickets假设，指出其性能增益无需权重空间的"稠密专家邻域"几何解释，而可由输出多样性、验证集选择与投票（PSV框架）解释，并提出冻结模型下的Logit PSV方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Neural Thickets假设认为预训练语言模型位于权重空间中任务专家构成的稠密邻域内，随机高斯扰动可揭示这些专家。作者质疑该几何解释是否为增益的必要来源。

Method: 复现原始增益；消融实验（仅扰动单个解码器block、完全冻结模型+输出logit加随机偏置）；提出Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV)通用框架（扰动生成预测器—小验证集筛选—聚合投票）；一阶分析证明小权重扰动主要通过诱导的logit偏移起作用；将分析扩展至视觉域（含对地观测）。

Result: 仅扰动单个解码器block即可恢复大部分提升；冻结模型加logit随机偏置在多数推理任务上匹配或超过全权重扰动；视觉域偏移下Logit PSV显著提升性能，而全权重扰动几乎无额外收益。

Conclusion: Neural Thickets的增益可由输出多样性、选择与投票获得，无需权重空间专家几何解释；Logit PSV在语言与视觉任务上提供了简单、免训练的替代方案。

Abstract: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions.
  This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.

</details>


### [372] [Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40654)
*Moshe Shenfeld,Eliad Tsfadia,Katrina Ligett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"提议-过滤-发布"(PFR)通用隐私原语：通过私有过滤输入，将只对"典型记录"满足友好差分隐私的机制升级为对所有输入满足标准差分隐私，且噪声尺度可贴合剩余数据，而非由少数极端记录的最坏情况影响决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计器通常在典型数据上准确稳定，却对少数可能记录敏感。差分隐私机制常按单条记录的最坏情况影响来缩放噪声，使少量极端记录主导了噪声尺度，即便其余数据本可支持更小噪声。直接删除这些记录可恢复较小尺度，但删除操作本身必须私有。

Method: PFR仅需两个组件：(1) 一个凹的"友好度"(friendliness)评分，衡量某条记录与数据集的契合程度；(2) 一个"友好-DP"发布机制，即当被改动记录与其余数据契合时满足差分隐私。PFR先提议候选记录、再私有过滤（基于凹友好度评分判定并剔除不合群记录）、最后在剩余数据上释放。对任意此类评分与发布机制，只要记录数满足公开条件，即可保证标准差分隐私。FriendlyCore可视为其一种实现。

Result: 在标量统计、主子空间估计、用户直方图的KL散度、图的等效电阻、以及处理规则选择五个场景中实例化PFR，均获得标准差分隐私保证，验证了其通用性。

Conclusion: PFR是一个与propose-test-release相当的通用隐私原语，能把典型情形下的友好DP机制转化为全输入上的标准DP，并让噪声尺度由剩余数据决定而非最坏情况记录，具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private.
  We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations.
  We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [373] [ICALL-BENCH: Benchmarking LLM Interprocedural Reasoning in Binary Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37871)
*Shenglong Yao,Zirui Liu,Xiangchi Yuan,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 ICALL-BENCH 基准，以间接调用目标恢复为可测量探针，直接评估 LLM 与智能体对编译后二进制程序跨过程语义的理解与推理能力，并系统比较纯模型推理、静态工具增强智能体与联网开放世界智能体三种分析范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准存在两方面局限：函数级基准难以揭示跨函数关系；整程序级基准多以最终任务结果评价，而任务常可凭局部线索解决，因而无法把跨过程推理与探索、工具使用、执行、检索等因素区分开，导致跨过程语义推理能力是否具备仍不明确。

Method: 构建 ICALL-BENCH：覆盖 50 个真实 C/C++ 完整程序，涵盖不同复杂度与多种优化配置，平均每程序 74,746 行代码、941 个函数；以间接调用目标恢复作为可测量的探针任务；设计三种分析范式——纯模型推理、静态工具增强智能体、联网开放世界智能体，用于分别考察内在推理、主动信息获取与外部知识对跨过程二进制分析的贡献；评测 5 个近期 LLM 及其对应智能体，并以程序级可验证成功率为指标。

Result: 不同模型与智能体之间差距显著，程序级可验证成功率在 23%–81% 区间；信息获取能力增强并不稳定带来更优结果，在最困难样本上提升尤为有限；即使在乐观评估设定下，模型表现不均衡且可验证失败频繁出现。

Conclusion: 更深入的信息访问无法替代跨过程推理本身，深层跨过程推理仍是主要瓶颈；稳健的二进制跨过程推理对当前 LLM 与智能体而言仍是未解决的开放挑战。

Abstract: Recent benchmarks show that LLMs achieve strong performance in both function-level binary understanding and end-to-end binary reverse engineering tasks, but whether LLMs can reason over interprocedural semantics in compiled binaries remains unclear. Function-level benchmarks offer limited visibility into cross-function relationships, while whole-program benchmarks typically evaluate final outcomes of tasks that may be solvable from local clues alone, making it difficult to disentangle interprocedural reasoning from exploration, tool use, execution, and retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce ICALL-BENCH, a benchmark that directly evaluates whether LLMs and agents can understand and reason over interprocedural semantics in binary programs, using indirect-call target recovery as a measurable probe. ICALL-BENCH covers 50 complete real-world C/C++ programs spanning different complexity levels and multiple optimization configurations, with an average of 74,746 lines of code and 941 functions per program. We further introduce three analysis regimes spanning model-only reasoning, static tool-augmented agents, and Internet-enabled open-world agents to examine how intrinsic reasoning, active information acquisition, and external knowledge each contribute to interprocedural binary analysis. We evaluate five recent LLMs and their corresponding agents. Our results reveal a wide separation across current models and agents, with program-level verifiable success rates ranging from 23% to 81%. They also show that greater information access does not consistently lead to better results, with particularly limited gains on the hardest cases, where deeper interprocedural reasoning remains the primary bottleneck. Uneven performance across models and frequent verifiable failures even under an optimistic evaluation indicate that robust binary interprocedural reasoning remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [374] [Cognitive Debt in the GenAI Era - Listening to Practitioners' Voices on the Loss of Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37888)
*Theocharis Tavantzis,Bianca Trinkenreich,Michaela Greiler,Júlia Condé Araújo,Marina Condé Araújo,Italo Santos,Alexander Serebrenik,Margaret-Anne Storey,Maria Teresa Baldassarre*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文通过灰文献综述（76篇来源）系统梳理AI辅助软件开发中"认知债"（cognitive debt）的概念化、表现形式、成因、后果及防控实践，指出认知债可在代码可运行、测试通过的表象下悄然累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发加速了代码生产，却可能削弱开发者对所构建系统的理解，形成"系统行为与开发者理解之间的鸿沟"，即认知债。该现象虽非新问题，但AI使其加剧；而学术研究滞后于实践者的博客与网络讨论，亟需从实践者视角梳理问题以指导后续研究与工程实践。

Method: 对76篇灰文献（博客文章、在线讨论等）进行灰文献综述，围绕四个维度展开分析：认知债的概念化与表现形式、促成因素、后果，以及预防/检测/缓解的实践。

Result: 发现认知债可在"代码能跑、测试能过"的情况下不被察觉地累积，尤其在开发者不加理解地直接采纳AI生成方案时；实践者报告的后果包括维护与调试更困难、团队知识碎片化、生产力下降；提出的实践包括记录设计理由、控制评审规模（review-sized changes）、设立理解门槛（comprehension gates）、知识共享仪式，以及以可靠性指标等信号来检测认知债。

Conclusion: 本研究为软件团队提供了AI辅助开发中新兴实践的结构化视图，强调在提升代码产出速度的同时必须保留人类理解，并呼吁后续学术研究跟进。

Abstract: Fast-paced AI-assisted software development risks reducing developers' understanding of the systems they build. This growing gap between what the system does and what developers understand about it, described as ``cognitive debt'', is not new, but AI has exacerbated it. This has led to a recent surge in blog posts and online discussions, in which practitioners recognize and write about cognitive debt, and share their experiences well before academic studies can capture them. To understand their concerns and inform future research and practice, we conduct a grey literature review of 76 sources, focusing on how cognitive debt is conceptualized and manifests, its contributing factors, its consequences, and the practices to prevent, detect, and mitigate it. We find that cognitive debt can accumulate unnoticed behind working code and passing tests, particularly when developers accept AI-generated solutions without building understanding. Practitioners report consequences such as harder maintenance and debugging, fragmented knowledge in the team, and reduced productivity. They propose practices such as documenting design rationale, review-sized changes, comprehension gates, and knowledge-sharing rituals, along with signals like reliability metrics to detect it. Our findings give software teams a structured view of emerging practical approaches in AI-assisted development and stress the need to preserve human understanding alongside faster code production.

</details>


### [375] [Reusable LLM-Based Plans with Probabilistic Guarantees for Self-Adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38039)
*Asher Tempest Arya,Rajan Maghera,Nicholas Wu Jiang,Federico Mora,Aren A. Babikian,Marsha Chechik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出验证器引导的框架，将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检验结合，为环境族中的每个实例提供概率需求保证，实现控制器的重用判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应系统需应对环境变体构成的环境族，每个实例均需满足概率需求；实例规模与结构变化使"保留、重用还是新建控制器"的决策困难，而控制器通常针对特定实例合成。现有LLM编写可重用控制器的工作多针对确定性领域，其输出的概率模型检验仅限于单实例初步研究。

Method: 提出面向环境族的控制器重用验证器引导框架：将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检验新颖结合，对每个实例提供概率需求的逐实例保证，并以此引导保留/重用/新建的适应决策；在三个基准、三种LLM上评估。

Result: 网格世界中，LLM编写的规则列表在约90%的留出实例上通过验证，基线最高仅77%；验证已存储规则列表比逐实例合成快15–103倍；重用以远低于生成或逐实例合成的成本服务大多数回合；模型检验反馈相对独立重启提升了验证覆盖率。

Conclusion: LLM编写控制器结合概率模型检验可有效支撑环境族级的控制器重用，兼顾逐实例概率保证、成本优势与覆盖率提升。

Abstract: Self-adaptive systems are designed to accommodate variants of their environment, which form a family of instances whose uncertainty is captured by probabilistic models, and must meet probabilistic requirements on each instance. Within such a family, changes in size and structure complicate the fundamental adaptation decision: whether to retain, reuse, or construct a new controller, since controllers are often synthesized for and specific to an instance. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been used to write reusable controllers, but existing approaches largely target deterministic domains, and probabilistic model checking of their output remains limited to preliminary single-instance studies. In this paper, we propose a verifier-guided framework for controller reuse with explicit support for families of environments. The framework introduces a novel combination of LLM-written controllers with probabilistic model checking to provide per-instance guarantees for probabilistic requirements. We evaluate our approach using three LLMs on three benchmarks, assessing its effectiveness and cost with respect to baseline implementations, the distribution of adaptation decisions, and the impact of individual framework components. On grid worlds, LLM-written rule lists are verified on about 90% of held-out instances, against at most 77% for the baselines, and verifying a stored rule list is 15 to 103 times faster than per-instance synthesis. Reuse serves most episodes at a small fraction of the cost of generation or per-instance synthesis, and model-checking feedback increases verified coverage over independent restarts.

</details>


### [376] [Understanding Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption: Practices, Challenges, and Evolution in Open-Source Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38054)
*Souhardya Saha Dip,Moshood A. Fakorede,Krishna Upadhyay,Umar Farooq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361次提交与5,713个issue，实证揭示PQC实现以维护为主（90%提交为既有支持维护），并构建11类技术挑战分类法，为迁移计划提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PQC标准化已确立量子安全算法，但软件项目如何实际实现与维护PQC支持缺乏实证证据，迁移规划缺少数据支撑。

Method: 对179个开源仓库的114,361次提交和5,713个issue进行挖掘；采用人工标注与经校验的LLM分类识别提交中的PQC算法、判定采纳状态与部署模式；对issue讨论归纳技术挑战；结合时间序列分析及NIST标准化里程碑前后的首次实现情况。

Result: 90%的PQC相关提交属于既有支持维护；构建11类技术挑战分类法，其中构建/打包/依赖故障与功能缺陷合计约占分类issue的一半；2024年标准化定稿后，标准化算法名称出现在超80%的PQC开发变更中，但Kyber等旧名仍持续出现；开发活动整体上升，但里程碑未带来首次实现的显著增长。

Conclusion: PQC迁移需考虑持续维护负担，优先保障构建可靠性与集成测试，并同时追踪标准化名称与旧算法名称；作者公开数据集、分类法、标注与分析流水线。

Abstract: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards establish algorithms for quantum-safe systems, but empirical evidence about how software projects implement and maintain PQC support remains limited. We investigate this implementation and maintenance work by mining 114,361 commits and 5,713 issues across 179 open-source repositories. We use human annotation and validated LLM classification to identify PQC algorithms in commits, classify their adoption status and deployment mode, and identify technical challenges in issue discussions. The commit classification for PQC algorithms reveals that 90% of commits concern maintenance of existing support. From the issue discussions, we construct an 11-category taxonomy of recurring technical challenges. Build, packaging, and dependency failures, along with functional defects, account for approximately half of categorized issues. To examine how PQC support evolves, we use time-series analysis and first implementations of individual algorithms within repositories around NIST standardization milestones. After the 2024 finalization, standardized algorithm names appeared in more than 80% of the PQC development changes analyzed, although earlier names such as Kyber continued to appear. Development activity increased over the observation period. Our milestone analysis, however, did not find a significant increase in first implementations. Migration plans should therefore account for sustained maintenance, prioritize build reliability and integration testing, and track both standardized and predecessor algorithm names. We make the dataset, taxonomy, annotations, and analysis pipeline publicly available.

</details>


### [377] [Template-Free Dynamic Invariant Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38130)
*Erfan Arvan,Michael D. Ernst,Martin Kellogg*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出Oca：用LLM替代模板库来提出动态不变式，并通过新的插桩、监测与delta调试机制解决LLM不变式执行时带来的副作用与死循环问题，从而同时提升表达力、有效性与性价比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动态不变式检测器（如Daikon）仅从固定模板库中提出候选不变式，表达力受限。LLM可以提出模板无法表达的、调用项目特定方法的不变式，有望同时提升表达力并降低推理成本。但LLM提出的不变式在求值时可执行任意代码，会引发副作用或无限循环。

Method: 1) 通过合适的提示与上下文选择，让LLM生成候选不变式（可与模板不变式并用）；2) 插桩：包装每个候选不变式，每线程同一时刻只求值一个不变式，防止嵌套求值无限触发；3) 对非嵌套挂起，监测每次运行的停滞并采用递增时间预算重试；4) 由于无法预先证明候选无副作用，在失败测试期间对已求值不变式做delta调试，定位并禁用有副作用的那一个，而不丢弃整次运行。以Oca实现并在真实开源Java项目上与Daikon对比。

Result: Oca的不变式表达力更强：平均28%的保留不变式调用了项目特定方法，Daikon模板无法表达；有效性更高：人工检查误报率18%，Daikon为76%；作为属性测试的性质更有用：在25个真实缺陷中发现9个，Daikon为4个；成本更低：566分钟与27 GB磁盘，Daikon为2,817分钟与827 GB。

Conclusion: LLM可作为模板的有效补充来生成动态不变式，配合插桩、停滞监测与delta调试等机制可安全地处理任意代码执行的副作用与挂起问题，在表达力、正确性、实用性与成本上均优于模板式检测器Daikon。

Abstract: A dynamic invariant detector proposes invariants, such as method pre- and postconditions, and rules out those that do not hold at run time. Traditional detectors propose invariants from a fixed library of templates, which limits their expressiveness. A large language model (LLM) can propose invariants instead of, or in addition to, template-derived ones. With the right prompt and context choices, we found that this idea can both improve the invariants' expressiveness and reduce the cost of inferring the invariants.
  Greater expressiveness brings complications: an LLM-proposed invariant can execute arbitrary code during invariant evaluation, causing side effects or infinite loops. Our novel instrumentation strategies mitigate these problems. We wrap each candidate and evaluate only one invariant per thread at a time, so nested invariant evaluations cannot trigger one another indefinitely. To recover from non-nested hangs, we monitor each run for stalls and retry it under a growing time budget. Because we cannot prove a candidate side-effect-free in advance, we use delta debugging over the invariants evaluated during a failing test to isolate and disable a side-effecting candidate without discarding the rest of the run.
  We compared our implementation, Oca, to the popular template-based Daikon invariant detector on real open-source Java projects. Oca produces more expressive invariants: on average, 28% of its held invariants call a project-specific method, which Daikon's templates cannot express. Its invariants are more often valid, with a false-positive rate of 18% in a manual inspection, vs. 76% for Daikon, and more useful: as properties for property-based testing, they exposed 9 of 25 real bugs, compared with 4 for Daikon. Oca also costs less, using 566 minutes and 27 GB of disk, compared with 2,817 minutes and 827 GB for Daikon.

</details>


### [378] [Mentorship, Interrupted: How GenAI Disrupts the GSoC Pipeline and Why Mentors Matter More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38167)
*Ruizhe Xing,Zixuan Feng,Mary Radomile,Stephanie Taylor,Sophia Vargas,Anita Sarma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了生成式AI（GenAI）如何改变Google Summer of Code（GSoC）中的导师制，发现GenAI虽助力入门、协调与初审，但削弱了提案、入选贡献与回答作为新人能力证据的可信度，导师的额外核查消耗了项目自我延续所需的时间与善意，并提出AIM决策框架以帮助组织选择可持续的GenAI应对策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI降低了开源贡献的生产成本，却使贡献更难反映贡献者本人的能力。在开源导师制中，导师依据新人作品判断其理解程度，新人则从反馈中学习，因此这一"信号失真"问题尤为关键。作者希望理解GenAI如何重塑导师制，并帮助组织制定可长期维持的应对方式。

Method: 采用混合质性方法：筛查GSoC受限导师邮件列表中2022年11月至2026年3月的全部讨论串，并访谈15名导师与组织管理者。

Result: GenAI在入门引导、协调和初审方面提供了帮助；但提案、入门贡献和新人回答作为能力证据的可靠性下降。导师通过额外核查弥补差距，而这占用了项目招募与自我延续所需的时间与社会善意，已有一个组织退出GSoC。各组织应对方式从禁止GenAI到接受GenAI不等，其划定的边界决定了由谁承担核查工作。

Conclusion: GenAI在导师制中兼具赋能与"信号稀释"的双重效应，核查成本被转嫁给导师，威胁项目可持续性。作者提出AIM决策框架，将可接受的GenAI使用、其融入导师流程的方式与导师容量三者关联，帮助组织选择自身可承受、可持续的应对策略。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) makes open source software (OSS) contributions cheaper to produce, and it makes them say less about the people who produced them. In OSS mentoring, that matters: mentors judge what newcomers understand from their work, and newcomers learn from mentors' feedback. We studied how GenAI is changing mentoring in Google Summer of Code (GSoC), a program in which today's mentees can become tomorrow's mentors. We screened every thread on GSoC's restricted mentors' mailing list from November 2022 through March 2026 and interviewed 15 mentors and organization administrators. GenAI helped with onboarding, coordination, and first-pass review, but proposals, entry contributions, and mentees' answers became weaker evidence of what newcomers could do. Mentors made up the difference by checking, and that checking drew on the same time and goodwill the program needs to renew itself; one organization had withdrawn from GSoC. Responses ranged from banning GenAI to accepting it, and the boundary an organization drew determined who did the checking. We propose AIM, a decision framework that links acceptable GenAI use, integration into the mentoring pipeline, and mentoring capacity, to help organizations choose responses they can sustain.

</details>


### [379] [Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38214)
*Aditya Golatkar,Alessandro Achille,Renos Zabounidis,Vlad Sobal,Yangruibo Ding,Baishakhi Ray,Jonathan Buck,Guy Van den Broeck,Maryam Fazel,Pietro Perona,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 Skeleton Coding：让开发者以高层类代码格式同时指定程序结构与行为规范，理论证明骨架可将所需测试数按指数级减少，实证中最佳骨架比最佳端到端行为规范降低 48.4% 平均测试误差，并显著缩小大小模型差距、降低实现成本、减少代码侵蚀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端行为规范（测试、输入输出示例）的充分性无法先验确定：它取决于由智能体自行决定的实现结构。同一组测试对一种结构充分，对另一种结构可能严重欠定，需要不同边界用例甚至指数级更多示例。开发者若不逆向分析数千行生成代码，就无法保证规范完备。

Method: 引入 Skeleton Coding：开发者以高层、类代码的格式与行为规范联合指定结构（数据类型、模块、函数的分解）；理论上将 AI 辅助编码建模为控制问题，分析骨架对测试数量的影响。

Result: 4 个模型、3 个基准上，最佳骨架相对最佳端到端行为规范将平均测试误差降低 48.4%；即使智能体可查询完整参考实现，加骨架仍相对降低最多 27.0%；骨架使大小模型平均差距缩小约 52.4%，实现成本降低 15–26 倍，代码侵蚀平均减少 24.7%。

Conclusion: 结构是规范充分性的隐藏决定因素，应由开发者与行为规范共同显式指定；骨架能在保持低规范成本的同时大幅提升可控性与生成质量。

Abstract: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

</details>


### [380] [Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38244)
*Haichao Zhu,Geyang Xu,Zhaorui Yang,Jiyuan Wang,Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究编码智能体在多个实现满足同一功能需求时，如何在新任务指令与仓库既有先例之间做取舍，提出并验证了决定影响与优先级信号的作用机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码只暴露过去的实现决策，却很少解释其理由。当智能体实现新功能或修改既有功能时，旧决策可能与新指令冲突，因此需要考察智能体如何在"沿袭现有代码"与"遵循新任务指令"之间抉择。

Method: 在专门构建的仓库中开展双向受控实验，并在真实开源仓库中验证。将指导来源隔离为三类：(1) 智能体默认偏好，(2) 仓库先例，(3) 显式任务指令。共进行 5,625 次试验，覆盖 4 个编码智能体、6 组实现对，并在跨 3 种编程语言的 4 个开源仓库中验证。

Result: 智能体共享相同的默认实现选择，但当仓库先例与默认冲突时压倒性地遵循先例（359/360）。先例影响力不均等：三个支持性本地文件带来 96% 采纳率，而同资源兄弟文件仅 4%；在示例数量固定时，仅改变文件位置即可使采纳率从 0% 升至 100%。当新任务意图与既有代码冲突时，书面优先级规则的联合成功率为 59/60，显著高于仅代码示例的 38/60；在开源仓库中，加载规则使联合成功率从 0/120 提升至 117/120。

Conclusion: 智能体倾向于遵循仓库先例，但先例影响力受体量、位置等因素调节；显式书面优先级规则优于单纯示例。据此提出设计决策可追溯性，应同时保留实现选择及其理由与优先级。

Abstract: Existing code reveals past implementation decisions but rarely explains the reasoning behind them. When coding agents implement new features or modify existing functionality, past decisions may conflict with new task instructions. This raises a fundamental question for agentic software evolution: when multiple implementations satisfy the same functional requirements, how do coding agents decide whether to follow existing code or new task instructions? We investigate this question through bidirectional, controlled experiments in purpose-built repositories, followed by validation in real-world open-source repositories. Our approach isolates three competing sources of guidance: (1) agents' default preferences, (2) repository precedents, and (3) explicit task instructions. We conduct 5,625 trials across four coding agents and six implementation pairs, with validation in four open-source repositories spanning three programming languages. We find that agents share the same default implementation choices, yet overwhelmingly follow repository precedent when it conflicts with those defaults (359/360 trials). Crucially, not all precedents carry equal influence: three supporting local files yield 96% adoption, compared with only 4% for sibling-resource files, and changing file placement alone can shift adoption from 0% to 100% at a fixed example count. When new task intent conflicts with existing code, written priority rules achieve substantially higher success than code examples alone (59/60 versus 38/60 joint successes for two agents on two implementation pairs). The effectiveness of explicit rules also extends to open-source repositories, where a harness-loaded rule raises joint success from 0/120 to 117/120. These findings motivate design-decision traceability that preserves not only implementation choices but also the rationale and priorities that should guide future changes.

</details>


### [381] [Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38311)
*Lam Nguyen Tung,Chenxi Gu,Xiaoning Du,Haoye Tian,Aldeida Aleti,Neelofar Neelofar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MetaReJ 是首个利用变形测试（metamorphic testing）检测 LLM-based APR 错误解释的方法，无需外部验证器，通过递归质询与矛盾检测实现，MCC 最高 0.43，超越已有方法最多 333.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的修复解释若错误会误导开发者对补丁可靠性的判断，需自动检测；但现有面向通用问答 LLM 的错误检测方法用于 APR 时存在两大局限：依赖不可用或缺乏 APR 推理能力的外部验证器，以及改写/重提示等采样策略产生冗余、重复原错误的表面响应。

Method: MetaReJ 受辩论与口头答辩（viva）启发，采用论辩式策略递归质询 LLM。它设计新颖的变形关系（MRs），在等价与非等价修复场景下递归提问并检测矛盾；为获得多样样本，将缺陷程序变换为保持或改变底层缺陷的变体，再询问 LLM 如何修复各变体；响应间的矛盾编码为 MR 违规，从而判定原解释错误。

Result: 在包含 1,756 条来自多个 LLM-based APR 系统解释的人工标注数据集上评估，MetaReJ 的 MCC 最高达 0.43，MCC 较先前方法提升最多 333.3%。

Conclusion: MetaReJ 证明了变形测试与论辩式递归质询可在不依赖外部验证器的前提下有效检测 APR 错误解释，显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: LLM-generated explanations help developers understand automated program repair (APR) rationale and assess patch quality. Incorrect explanations can mislead developers about a repair's reliability, making their detection important. However, manually inspecting the growing volume of generated repairs is impractical, motivating automated detection.
  Existing methods mainly target incorrect answers from general question-answering LLMs, often by sampling multiple responses and detecting contradictions. Applied to APR, they face two limitations: (1) they may depend on external verifiers that are unavailable or lack APR-specific reasoning; and (2) sampling strategies such as paraphrasing or re-prompting the same input often yield superficial, redundant responses that repeat the original error rather than expose it.
  We propose MetaReJ, the first method designed to detect incorrect APR explanations using metamorphic testing. Inspired by debate and viva examinations, MetaReJ challenges explanations through an argumentative strategy without requiring external verifiers. It applies novel metamorphic relations (MRs) to recursively question the LLM under equivalent and non-equivalent repair scenarios and detect contradictions. To obtain diverse samples, MetaReJ transforms the buggy program into variants that preserve or alter the underlying bug, then asks the LLM how to repair each variant. Contradictions among responses are encoded as MR violations, which indicate that the original explanation is incorrect. We evaluate MetaReJ on a manually labelled dataset of 1,756 explanations from multiple LLM-based APR systems. MetaReJ achieves an MCC of up to 0.43, outperforming prior methods by up to 333.3% in MCC.

</details>


### [382] [DIFUZZI: A Differential Fuzzing Tool for Code Functional Similarity Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38337)
*Simantika Bhattacharjee Dristi,Matthew B. Dwyer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DIFUZZI 自动化差分模糊测试中输入生成器的合成，借助基于 LLM 的迭代验证与修复，降低人工成本，扩展差分模糊测试的适用范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程中的优化、重构等任务需要保持组件行为并评估功能相似性。形式化等价性证明不具备可扩展性且无法量化相似程度；机器学习近似方法在存在细微语义差异时表现不佳；差分模糊测试虽可扩展，但需大量人工构建适配目标程序对的输入生成器。

Method: 提出 DIFUZZI，引入基于 LLM 的生成器合成步骤，并对合成结果进行迭代验证与修复，从而将差分模糊测试前的输入生成器构建自动化。

Result: 摘要未给出量化实验结果；工具已开源（github.com/Dristi123/difuzzi_tool）并附演示视频。

Conclusion: 通过自动化生成器合成，DIFUZZI 为差分模糊测试的更广泛应用铺平道路。

Abstract: A range of software engineering tasks, such as optimization and refactoring, seek to preserve the behavior of software components and require methods to assess functional similarity. Research has explored formal approaches to prove functional equivalence and used machine learning methods to approximate it, but the former does not scale and does not quantify the extent of similarity and the latter struggles when subtle semantic differences are present.
