Differential fuzzing offers a scalable approach for differencing programs semantically, but applying it often requires substantial manual effort to construct input generators that are well-suited to a target pair of programs. To address this challenge, we introduce DIFUZZI, which incorporates an LLM-based generator synthesis step that is iteratively validated and repaired. By automating this step, DIFUZZI paves the way for broader applicability of differential fuzzing. We release DIFUZZI at https://github.com/Dristi123/difuzzi_tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/FlHNOHuo9WE

</details>


### [383] [Security Impact of Coding Agent's Memory Files](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38521)
*Thiago Santos de Moura,Selma Güler,Yannic Noller*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 项目记忆文件（如CLAUDE.md）构成编码智能体的新型攻击面：恶意记忆文件对secure completion的影响有限且不一致（-8至+6个百分点），但智能体向开发者披露该文件的程度差异显著，且显式告警不足以保证代码安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体会话开始时会加载CLAUDE.md等记忆文件并视为可信指导，任何能通过PR修改该文件的人都能在不触碰开发者提示词的情况下操纵智能体。作者据此将记忆文件视为不安全代码生成的攻击面，重点考察两点：恶意记忆文件能否诱导生成"测试通过但有漏洞"的代码，以及智能体是否向开发者披露该文件对代码的影响。

Method: 针对12类CWE各构造两个恶意记忆文件——"qualified"变体将移除防御性检查包装为工程最佳实践，"forceful"变体直接要求移除；在36个SecRepoBench任务上，分别以有无这些文件为条件，运行Claude Code（Sonnet 5.5）与OpenCode（Qwen 3.8 27B、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）。

Result: 恶意文件使secure completion率变化-8至+6个百分点，跨智能体与变体无一致模式。披露行为差异明显：Claude Code在约三分之二的最终消息中提及该文件，OpenCode几乎只在推理轨迹中提及，最终消息中不提。将文件显式标记为攻击也不能可靠保护代码，此类智能体仍生成有漏洞的代码。

Conclusion: 记忆文件是真实但影响幅度有限的攻击面，主要风险在于披露不透明与告警机制失效；需开展更大规模研究以跨智能体量化该风险并设计防御。

Abstract: Coding agents automatically load project memory files such as CLAUDE.md at the start of every session and treat them as trusted project guidance. Anyone who can change such a file, for example through a pull request, can therefore steer the agent without ever touching the developer's prompt. We study memory files as an attack surface for insecure code generation and ask (1) whether a malicious memory file makes agents produce code that passes its tests but is vulnerable, and (2) whether agents disclose to the developer that the file shaped their code. For each of 12 CWE classes, we crafted two malicious memory files, a qualified variant that presents removing defensive checks as engineering best practice and a forceful variant that demands it. We ran Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) and OpenCode (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) on 36 SecRepoBench tasks with and without these files. The malicious files changed the rate of secure completions by -8 to +6 percentage points, with no consistent pattern across agents or variants. Agents differ sharply in what they tell the developer about the file. Claude Code names it in about two thirds of its final messages, whereas OpenCode mentions it almost exclusively in its reasoning trace, not in the final message the developer reads. Flagging the file as an attack does not reliably protect the code, as such agents still generated vulnerable code. We outline the larger studies needed to quantify this risk across agents and to design defenses.

</details>


### [384] [Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38610)
*Yijun Liao,Fanwei Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文检验了LLM智能体失败修复中各类评估器（贪心重放、更强模型、环境oracle、日志判官）是否真正选出对实际执行策略有帮助的修复，结论是应以部署策略自身的rollout作为验证执行器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有修复方法需决定替换哪一步动作及替换内容，通常用贪心重放、更强模型、环境oracle或读日志的判官来给候选修复打分。作者质疑这些评估器是否能选出对“真正执行修复的智能体”有益的修复，即评估器与执行器是否错配。

Method: 固定失败轨迹与候选单步修复，用部署策略的独立rollout为每个候选标注真实部署价值，再测量各评估器所选修复相对该基准损失多少价值。在ALFWorld与WebShop上做预注册检验；比较同预算下用更强模型rollout（Qwen2.5-14B）与部署模型自身（7B）rollout的选优效果；考察跨家族同规模模型的双向损失，以及评分执行器对修复位置标签和方法排名的影响。

Result: 在未按修复价值筛选的失败上，贪心重放相对部署智能体自身rollout选择，在ALFWorld的期望净成功增益上损失0.08–0.13，在WebShop净奖励上损失0.06–0.13。等rollout预算下，用14B rollout为7B选修复，损失ALFWorld 0.25、WebShop 0.07；每候选20次14B rollout不超过7B自身2次rollout；新rollout证实两模型在分歧案例上偏好相反修复。不同家族同规模模型间，两环境均出现双向损失（0.07–0.17）。评分执行器还会改变修复位置标签与方法排名。

Conclusion: 修复必须用将要实际执行它的执行器来验证；修复标签/基准应显式标明其执行器，避免评估器与执行器错配导致的价值损失与不可比的排名结论。

Abstract: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.

</details>


### [385] [When LLM Architectures Meet Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection: a Replication Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38621)
*Gerardo Iuliano,Gabriele De Vito,Dario Di Nucci*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对 Chen 等人关于 LLM 智能合约漏洞检测的实证研究进行扩展复现：在 GPT-4 上精确复现其"高召回、低精确"模式，并对 MoE、RNN 类及状态空间模型进行差异化复现，发现该模式不能按架构族均匀迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能合约漏洞检测证据几乎完全建立在 GPT 系列所用的稠密 Transformer 架构和已计划弃用的模型快照之上，无法判断所报告的检测行为是 LLM 的一般性质，还是特定架构设计的产物。

Method: 采用扩展复现设计：先在 GPT-4 上按原协议进行精确复现作为基线，再做差异化复现，将协议迁移到基于 MoE 与类 RNN 设计的代表性模型，并尝试对状态空间模型进行初步评估。

Result: 精确复现证实了 Chen 等人的结论，包括 GPT-4 上的高召回、低精确检测模式；差异化复现显示该模式并非一致迁移。GPT-4 与 Gemma-3 参数量相差约两个数量级却呈现相同的稠密 Transformer 定性特征，而两个不同谱系的 MoE 模型表现定性相异。

Conclusion: 仅凭架构族不足以预测漏洞检测档案；架构内部差异（如同一族内行为分化）同样关键，因此先前基于 GPT 系模型的结论不宜外推至其他架构的 LLM。

Abstract: Smart contracts are immutable programs deployed on blockchain platforms, where vulnerabilities can translate directly into financial loss. Among the techniques proposed for their detection, recent work has relied increasingly on Large Language Models (LLMs) guided by carefully crafted prompts. However, the evidence accumulated so far rests almost entirely on the dense Transformer architecture behind the GPT line and on model snapshots already scheduled for deprecation, leaving open the question of whether the reported behaviors reflect a general property of LLMs or an artifact of that specific design.
  This paper presents an extended replication of the empirical study by Chen et al. on LLM-based smart contract vulnerability detection. We replicate the original protocol on GPT-4 as a baseline, followed by a differentiated replication, executing the protocol on representative models based on Mixture-of-Experts and RNN-like designs, together with an attempted preliminary evaluation of State Space Models. The exact replication confirms the findings of Chen et al., including the high-recall, low-precision detection pattern they report on GPT-4. Nevertheless, the differentiated replication shows that this pattern does not transfer uniformly across the evaluated models. Those from the same architectural family may also exhibit different behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the resulting detection profile. We observe the same qualitative dense-Transformer profile in both GPT-4 and Gemma-3, despite a gap of roughly two orders of magnitude in parameter counts, whereas two Mixture-of-Experts models from different lineages exhibit qualitatively divergent behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the detection profile.

</details>


### [386] [The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38628)
*Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi,Oliver Weissl,Johannes Betz,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对4195篇文献筛选出的235项原始研究进行系统映射，刻画ADS测试"现实差距"的测量与缓解方式，并区分"真实世界信息"与"评估证据"；指出仅有61项研究使用多族指标，尚无法建立差距与测试结论间的因果联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真对自动驾驶系统（ADS）测试至关重要，但仿真与现实之间的差异（reality gap）可能削弱测试结论的有效性；现有文献中究竟针对哪些差异、以何种证据支撑"保真性/一致性"主张尚不清晰，需系统梳理。

Method: 系统性映射研究（systematic mapping）：从4195篇出版物中筛选235篇测量或缓解现实差距的原始研究，按目标、对象、方法、实验设置与评估证据进行编码分类；将ADS测试划分为6类组件，分别标识仿真执行与真实世界执行，并对每类方法及其评估参照分别处理，从而把"用于构建方法的真实世界信息"与"用于评价其主张的证据"区分开来。

Result: 76%的研究聚焦于缓解（mitigation），主要针对场景与交通参与者真实感及感知；94%报告了验证或测量程序；但仅61篇研究报告了覆盖多指标族（传感器/感知一致性、ADS行为、车辆动力学、安全结果）的度量，且该覆盖不足以建立差异与测试判定之间的因果联系。

Conclusion: 真实世界内容与物理执行必须相对于所评估的具体主张（claim）来解读；研究呼吁采用"主张特定"的评估与组件级报告，以厘清哪些差异会影响测试结论、以及何时仿真证据能支撑关于真实世界ADS行为的结论。

Abstract: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.

</details>


### [387] [Write Once, Instrument Anywhere: Portable, Sandboxed Tooling with WebAssembly Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38682)
*Elizabeth Gilbert,Chris Fallin,Heather Miller,Ben L. Titzer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Splicer 是一个基于 WebAssembly 组件（component）与 interposition（插桩/拦截）机制的框架，用于对已部署软件进行语义丰富、可插拔且沙箱隔离的监控与调试，克服传统工具在类型语义、可组合性、生态碎片化和权限过宽方面的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨切面关注点（监控、调试）在软件生态中普遍存在，但现有工具链碎片化：高层框架提供应用级类型与语义却绑定特定语言/运行时/硬件架构；为可移植性而转向底层插桩（如 eBPF 在进程边界处插桩）虽能力强，却带来四个问题：(1) 应用级类型与低层字节/数据包之间的取舍；(2) 领域专用工具不可组合；(3) 各框架特性碎片化；(4) 工具常以无限制权限访问程序及其环境。

Method: 提出 Splicer：一个 WebAssembly 组件 interposition 框架，通过组件模型提供语义丰富的应用级类型；支持可插拔的工具（pluggable tooling）并赋予其强大能力；借助跨语言、跨硬件的移植减少生态碎片化；并将每个工具限制在沙箱中、仅授予显式声明的权限。

Result: 在一组基准测试上评估 Splicer，展示了由多种源语言编写的非平凡工具的可插拔性及其性能表现。

Conclusion: Splicer 通过 WebAssembly 组件 interposition 统一了应用级语义、工具可插拔性、跨语言/硬件可移植性与细粒度沙箱权限，为部署态软件的监控与调试提供了一种兼顾表达力、可组合性与安全性的方案，并在多语言工具场景下验证了可行性与性能。

Abstract: Monitoring and debugging deployed software is crucial for scalability, performance, and robustness. Cross-cutting concerns are pervasive across software ecosystems, yet engineers must address them with a fragmented toolbox. While high-level frameworks exist to offer application-level types and semantics, they often lock a solution into specific languages, runtimes, or hardware architectures. Portability often forces engineers to choose lower-level instrumentation mechanisms. For example, in-language frameworks can trace a request across processes, but multi-language contexts require instrumentation at the boundary, for example using eBPF. While these frameworks provide powerful capabilities, they often result in 1) a tradeoff between application-level types or low-level bytes and packets, 2) non-composable domain-specific tools, 3) feature fragmentation across frameworks, and 4) tools that often run with unrestricted access to the program and its environment.
  We address these problems with Splicer, a WebAssembly component interposition framework that 1) provides semantically rich application-level types, 2) enables pluggable tooling with powerful capabilities, 3) reduces ecosystem fragmentation through porting across languages and hardware, and 4) confines each tool to a sandbox with explicitly granted permissions. We evaluate Splicer on a suite of benchmarks demonstrating the pluggability of non-trivial tooling written in multiple source languages and their performance.

</details>


### [388] [When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38800)
*Wesley K. G. Assunção,Ramesh Periyathambi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出“操作性上下文有效性”（operational context validity）这一新的检索原则，并实现CASE框架，将仓库工件与运行时配置及架构演化关联，把证据分为有效/无效/未知三类，生成区分可执行指导与历史依据的上下文包。初步实验表明传统检索会把16个不兼容工件当作可执行证据，而CASE可将其排除并保留全部适用工件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体依赖检索到的代码与开发历史指导修改，但语义相似度或时间新近性无法判断检索信息在特性开关、架构迁移、部署特定配置下是否仍然适用，导致高相关但已失效的工件误导实现决策。

Method: 提出操作性上下文有效性准则（依赖任务、部署与时间），并实例化为与智能体无关的CASE框架：连接仓库工件、运行时配置与架构演化，将证据分类为valid/invalid/unknown，生成区分可执行指导、历史理由与未解决约束的上下文包；通过6个开发任务、15个工件、3种部署的可复现初步评估验证可行性。

Result: 传统检索将16次不兼容工件暴露为可执行证据，CASE在原型参考规则下将其排除并保留全部适用工件；时间新近性过滤使有效召回降至0.43，从CASE中移除特性开关证据使其降至0.13。

Conclusion: 结果仅证明可行性而非提升编码智能体正确性，但揭示了基于相关性检索的局限，并引出新研究方向：让编码智能体不仅推理信息是否相关，还要判断其在操作层面是否仍然有效。

Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly rely on retrieved code and development history to guide software changes. However, highly relevant artifacts may describe implementations that are inactive or incompatible with the target deployment. Neither semantic similarity nor recency establishes whether retrieved information remains applicable under feature flags, architectural migrations, and deployment-specific configurations. We challenge relevance-oriented retrieval by introducing operational context validity, a task-, deployment-, and time-dependent criterion for determining whether software evidence can legitimately guide implementation decisions. We instantiate this new retrieval principle in CASE, an agent-agnostic framework that connects repository artifacts with runtime configurations and architectural evolution, classifies evidence as valid, invalid, or unknown, and generates context packages distinguishing actionable guidance from historical rationale and unresolved constraints. We investigate its feasibility through a reproducible preliminary evaluation involving six development tasks, 15 artifacts, and three deployments. Conventional retrieval exposes 16 incompatible artifact occurrences as actionable, whereas CASE excludes them while retaining all applicable artifacts under the prototype's reference rules. Recency filtering reduces valid recall to 0.43, while removing feature-flag evidence from CASE reduces it to 0.13. Although these results demonstrate feasibility rather than improvements in coding-agent correctness, they reveal limitations of relevance-based retrieval and motivate a new research direction: enabling coding agents to reason not only about which information is relevant, but also whether it remains operationally valid.

</details>


### [389] [Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38977)
*Prashank Kadam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过系统综述与受控重评估，检验LLM代码质量改进技术的可靠性：多数技术仅测自身目标维度、单信号易被投机，等算力下best-of-n采样可匹配或超越多种复杂方法，且在66项技术对比中仅1项显著优于best-of-n（与随机一致）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM功能正确性基准已接近饱和，但"通过测试"不代表代码可读、高效或安全。现有改进技术证据零散、通常只覆盖单一质量维度，且很少在等算力预算下比较，缺乏系统且可比的评估。

Method: 两步：（1）系统文献综述，覆盖2021年7月至2026年10月的628篇原始研究（作者审阅、披露LLM辅助），按阶段、信号来源与质量目标对技术分类；（2）受控重评估：在四个模型、等算力预算下运行十种技术，评估正确性、可维护性、效率与安全性；扩展至13个当前模型与仓库级任务；在Gemma 4 31B上对66项重点技术做头对头比较，并以不依赖技术自身信号的指标衡量。

Result: 单次调用下，质量提示仅提高分析器告警数，复杂度与评委评分几乎不变；等预算下，分析器加权排序的best-of-n在未优化指标上匹配或超过提示、规划、自我精炼、评审agent与检索方法；分析器反馈循环与微调仅在分析器告警数上占优。HumanEval+上出现的大幅正确性下降未在训练截止后的新竞赛题上重现（提示基准污染）。头对头中66项技术仅1项在其主目标上以95%区间显著超过best-of-n，比例与随机一致。

Conclusion: 多数代码质量改进技术的增益不稳健或可被单一自动信号投机。建议今后报告应（1）对照等算力预算的采样基线，（2）采用与技术自身信号独立的评估指标，并披露方差、算力与污染情况。

Abstract: Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.

</details>


### [390] [Do Open-Source Video Ad Clients Follow VAST 4.3? An Empirical Study of Player Conformance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39093)
*Prashant Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文从VAST 4.3规范中抽取108条要求，对6个开源VAST客户端（8种配置）在Node.js与5款浏览器上进行实测，发现普遍存在必须级偏差，并发布测试框架与测试向量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频广告通过VAST文档在流媒体与联网电视应用中投放，企业依据播放器客户端库发出的HTTP请求统计广告。追踪错误可能不影响播放却导致后续广告计数不一致，因此需要量化开源客户端对VAST 4.3播放器职责的符合程度、结论是否依赖运行时、生成式输入的价值以及偏差引入的版本。

Method: 从规范抽取108条需求形成目录；6个开源客户端、8种配置运行69个手工构造测试向量与IAB样例标签，在Node.js及三引擎的5款浏览器中执行并记录全部请求；辅以网格测试、模糊测试和跨36个版本的扫描，并以闭源Google IMA SDK作对照。

Result: 共得78项发现，各配置存在3–21处必须级偏差；遵循Wrapper重定向链的开源客户端均未在Wrapper请求中填充必需宏，而对照的IMA 3.794.0可正确填充；某库超时抛出无法捕获的异常，导致Node.js进程终止；在pod连播场景中某播放器将前一广告的完成归因到下一广告，已于5.3.0修复；某库在jsdom下符合规范，但在所有受测Chrome与Safari系浏览器中偏离。

Conclusion: 受测客户端在用于广告计数与诊断的职责上分歧显著；在真实浏览器中运行的共享一致性测试套件可暴露多数分级偏差，测试框架与向量已开源发布。

Abstract: Context. Video ads reach streaming and connected-TV apps through VAST documents, and companies count ads from the HTTP requests the player's client library sends. A tracking error can leave playback intact and surface later as disagreeing counts.
  Objective. To measure how far open-source VAST clients meet the player duties of VAST 4.3, whether verdicts depend on the runtime, what generated inputs add, and when deviations were introduced.
  Method. A catalog of 108 requirements was extracted from the specification. Six open-source clients in eight configurations ran against 69 crafted test vectors and the IAB's sample tags, under Node.js and in five browsers on three engines, with every request recorded. Grids, fuzzing and a sweep over 36 releases extend the catalog; Google's closed IMA SDK is a comparison.
  Results. The open-source clients have 78 findings and 3 to 21 must-level deviations per configuration. None of the tested open-source clients that follow redirect (Wrapper) chains fills the required macros in a Wrapper's request; the archived IMA 3.794.0 configuration tested does. One library's timeout throws an exception no caller can catch, ending a Node.js process. In a pod (ads played back to back), one player credits a finishing ad's completion to the next ad, fixed in release 5.3.0. A library can conform under jsdom and deviate in every tested Chrome- and Safari-family browser.
  Conclusions. The tested clients diverge on the duties other companies use to count and diagnose ads. A shared conformance suite run in real browsers could expose most graded deviations; the harness and vectors are released.

</details>


### [391] [PyReprism: A Shared Lexical Foundation for Polyglot Code Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39224)
*Daniel Ogenrwot,Jorge Gonzalo Delgado Cervantes,Richard Sserunjogi,John Businge*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PYREPRISM 是一个开源 Python 库与命令行工具，通过将语言特定的词法处理与可复用分析解耦：每种语言仅需声明其词法表面（生成无损的类型化 token 流），所有分析只在该 token 流上实现一次，从而统一多语言仓库的实证分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言仓库的实证研究常对语料中每种语言施加相同分析（如分离代码与注释、计算度量、规范化标识符、重复代码筛查）。由专用工具拼装会带来语言覆盖范围、测量约定与工作流上的差异，难以保证分析的一致性。

Method: 提出 PYREPRISM：语言特定声明（lexical surface）与共享分析相分离的架构。每种语言仅声明词法规则，产出无损的类型化 token 流；每项分析（注释/字符串识别、度量计算、标识符规范化、克隆筛查等）在 token 流上统一实现一次。内置 187 种语言，语言特定声明长度中位数 16 行，且无任何语言覆写共享分析。评估上使用参考解析器作为基准，在 12 种未参与分词器开发的语言、1,412 个文件上测试注释与字符串分类；并在多语言仓库上对比工具数量与运行时间。

Result: 注释与字符串分类达到 F1 = 0.994 与 0.958；单一工具替代三个工具；在输入与分析操作匹配条件下，单核运行时间为 2.9s，对比 8.7s。同时刻画了词法分析在复杂度估计与克隆筛查方面的局限。

Conclusion: 以"词法声明 + 共享分析"的解耦设计可在低实现成本（中位数 16 行/语言）下覆盖 187 种语言，并在未参与开发的语种上保持高精度与显著效率优势；但词法层面的方法在复杂度估计与克隆筛查上存在固有不足，需明确其适用边界。

Abstract: Empirical studies of polyglot repositories apply the same analyses to every language of a corpus, such as separating code from comments, computing metrics, normalizing identifiers, and screening for duplicated code. Assembling them from specialized tools introduces differences in language coverage, measurement conventions, and workflows. We present PYREPRISM, an open-source Python library and command-line tool that separates language-specific lexical processing from reusable analyses: each language declares its lexical surface, which yields a lossless stream of typed tokens, and every analysis is implemented once on that stream. Across 187 built-in languages, language-specific declarations have a median length of 16 lines, and no language overrides a shared analysis. Against a reference parser, comment and string classification reach F1 scores of 0.994 and 0.958 on 1,412 files in 12 languages that were never used to develop the tokenizer. In a study of a polyglot repository, one tool replaces three; with matched inputs and analysis operations, it takes 2.9s instead of 8.7s on one core. We also characterize where lexical analysis falls short, in complexity estimation and clone screening. Tool: https://github.com/unlv-evol/PyReprism Video: https://youtu.be/IXc-NP5t4GU

</details>


### [392] [Omission-Safe Conditional Contracts for Evidence-Closed CI Qualification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39241)
*Zhiheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种"资格判定"方法：在不知目标是否存在的情况下，把固定的CI工作流编译为条件式作业需求，保留固定采集清单，并由独立实现校验源完整的推导证书，从而防止"漏项自我豁免"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续集成证据具有条件性：工作流决定哪些作业应当运行，而归档决定哪些作业仍可观测。若仅凭观测反推需求，则一旦遗漏某个作业，其对应义务也随之被抹除（omission erases its own obligation），造成授权被不当放大，因此需要一种对遗漏免疫的判定机制。

Method: 将钉定的（pinned）工作流在编译期独立于目标存在性转换为条件式作业需求；维持固定的采集清单；由独立实现检查"源完整"的推导证书。在固定源、上下文、范围与绑定宇宙下，要求义务与应用性判定在信息扩展时保持既有真值，从而证明撤回观测事实不能产生新授权。实现支持静态矩阵、依赖守卫与有界钉定可复用工作流，保留未知应用性，并将可容忍结果与证据覆盖度分离。采用双实现互校。

Result: 两套实现均与45条人工规定的授权控制项一致，拒绝180个源证书攻击，在704种不同的正当开发删除下均未出现授权增益；一次显式见证的12作业平台运行在两套实现中均通过判定，全部4,095种正当载荷子集删除均阻断授权。冻结数据集包含6个项目、8个工作流家族共240次运行：160份评测源证书全部独立通过校验，但历史执行源身份不可得，实际资格判定仍保持开放；初始门控诊断在155/160次运行上一致，引入保留未知传播的修复后在回溯重跑中达到160/160一致。

Conclusion: 研究确立了有界源提取与遗漏抗性，而非自然故障流行度或产出者真实性；实际资格判定受限于历史源身份缺失，保持开放。

Abstract: Continuous-integration evidence is conditional: a workflow determines which jobs should run, while an archive records which jobs remain observable. Reconstructing requirements from those observations lets an omission erase its own obligation. We present a qualification method that compiles a pinned workflow into conditional job requirements independently of target presence, retains a fixed capture inventory, and checks source-complete derivation certificates with a separate implementation. For a fixed source, context, scope and binding universe, with sound obligations and applicability judgments that preserve established truth under information extension, withdrawing observation facts cannot create authorization. The implementation handles static matrices, dependency guards and bounded pinned reusable workflows, preserving unknown applicability and separating tolerated outcomes from evidence coverage. Both implementations match the 45 hand-specified authorization controls, reject 180 source-certificate attacks, and exhibit no authorization gain over 704 distinct proper development erasures. An explicitly witnessed 12-job platform run qualifies in both implementations; all 4,095 proper payload-subset erasures block authorization. A frozen collection spans 240 runs in eight workflow families across six projects. All 160 evaluation source certificates independently validate, but unavailable historical execution-source identities leave actual qualification open. Initial gate diagnoses agree on 155/160 runs; a preserved unknown-propagation repair yields 160/160 agreement in a retrospective rerun. The study establishes bounded source extraction and omission resistance, rather than natural-fault prevalence or producer authenticity.

</details>


### [393] [QSoftCore: A Conceptual Foundation for Quantum Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39406)
*Tao Yue,Yuechen Li,Man Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出概念模型QSoftCore，从软件工程视角重组既有的量子计算概念，统一指代量子应用、问题、算法、配置、程序、范式特定计算规约，并关联状态演化、执行结果与后端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子软件工程（QSE）需理解应用需求、量子程序与算法、计算范式、执行与部署，但相关QC概念分散于物理、数学及范式特定抽象层，导致QSE社群及所提方法难以一致地引用这些概念。

Method: 构建QSoftCore概念模型，以软件工程视角重新组织已确立的QC概念，显式连接量子应用、计算问题、算法、配置、程序、范式特定计算规约与状态演化、执行结果、后端；并针对QSE文献中关键软件工程活动进行评估。

Result: 评估表明QSoftCore可在QSE全生命周期内，为量子计算、执行、部署配置、后端及测量证据提供共享的QC指代物（referents）。

Conclusion: QSoftCore为QSE提供了统一的概念指代框架，缓解跨抽象层的概念不一致问题，支撑软件工程活动中的一致引用与衔接。

Abstract: Quantum software engineering (QSE) requires understanding application requirements, quantum programs and algorithms, quantum computation paradigms, executions, and deployment. However, relevant quantum computing (QC) concepts are often defined across physical, mathematical, and paradigm-specific levels of abstraction, making it difficult for the QSE community and hence proposed methods to refer to them consistently. To this end, we present QSoftCore, a conceptual model that reorganizes established QC concepts from a software engineering perspective and connects quantum applications, computational problems, algorithms, configurations, programs, and paradigm-specific computation specifications with state evolution, execution results, and backends. Our assessment against QSE literature across key software engineering activities indicates that QSoftCore provides shared QC referents for quantum computations, executions, deployment configurations, backends, and measurement evidence across the QSE lifecycle.

</details>


### [394] [Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39417)
*Zhonghao Jiang,Xuyang Zheng,Yanfu Yan,Zhongxin Liu,Lingfeng Bao,Shuiguang Deng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 ExLabel——一种基于 LLM、自演化、经验引导的 SWE 数据集任务清晰度与测试覆盖度评估助手，配合新基准 SWE-TQ 实现更可靠的实例质量筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-bench 类数据集中任务清晰度与测试覆盖度直接决定实例是否可解、可验证，但现有数据集质量存在问题；人工标注成本高，而现有 LLM 标注依赖静态、过于通用的评分准则（rubric），难以应对多样细粒度场景，误报率高。人类标注者依靠积累经验做上下文感知判断，本文希望将这一机制引入自动评估。

Method: ExLabel 维护一个持续演化的经验库，将跨实例知识蒸馏为稳定而自适应的判断准则，并在评估新实例时检索复用相关经验进行引导；为系统评估，作者从 SWE-bench 与 Multi-SWE-bench 的人工标注中清洗构建覆盖八种编程语言的 SWE-TQ 基准，并在三种骨干 LLM 上验证。

Result: 在全部设置下 F1 最优；相较最佳基线，Python/多语言子集上任务清晰度评估相对提升 44.2%/49.9%，测试覆盖度评估相对提升 24.0%/18.4%。用 ExLabel 过滤 SWE-rebench 数据微调的编码模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决 66.2% 的问题，比最佳基线过滤数据训练的模型高 14.5%。

Conclusion: 经验驱动的自演化评估范式显著优于静态通用准则，可用于高质量 SWE 数据集的构建、训练数据筛选与评测可靠性提升；配套 SWE-TQ 基准为后续研究提供可复现的评估基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.

</details>


### [395] [Soei: Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent for Multi-Agent AI Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39468)
*Mohammed Nayeem Khan,K S Sarun Kumar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对AI编码智能体的长程、多会话工作，提出并验证可观测性方案：先审计开源工具Agenttrail，再用45个真实会话量化“缺乏独立验证的完成声明”等问题，最后提出基于事件schema、哈希链账本与PROV图的Soei系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体已能在少监督下进行长程、多步骤、跨会话的软件开发；开发者回归工作时真正关心的是“做了什么、由谁做、是否完成”，而现有可观测工具缺乏对意图、证据与完成声明之间关系的刻画。

Method: 三部分：(1) 对Agenttrail（commit e4ba2da）做源码级审计；(2) 在45个真实会话（102,233条记录、20,577次工具执行、2,336个人机回合）上运行原型，并用盲审分类器估计无独立验证的编辑回合比例与无证据的完成声明比例，另做时序启发式与会话时长分析；(3) 提出Soei：确认感知事件schema、哈希链本地账本、W3C PROV对齐图、校准归因与血统推断、以及区分“完成声明”与“证明”的验证层。

Result: Agenttrail审计：9个文档化常量/机制在文件与行级成立，两条事件管线从未统一，Map服务存在未认证的本地变更面。经验结果：23.4%（95% CI 17.1–35.7）的代码编辑回合在最后一次编辑后无独立检查；57.8%被标记完成的待办在编辑与完成之间无证据；10分钟时序启发式仅找回内容血统关联的24对会话中的6对；42%会话超过24小时，48.1%的转录字节超出2 MiB回放上限，16个会话中共1,326条记录含疑似凭据字符串。Soei在相同语料上：账本为原始体积20%、不存内容与凭据、验证吞吐约126k事件/s、可检测篡改并确定性回放。

Conclusion: 现有智能体工作流中“完成声明”普遍缺乏可验证证据，且现有工具在事件统一性、安全面与回放可行性上存在缺陷；Soei通过证据化事件、防篡改账本与血统推断将声明与证明分离，并给出一套带证据门控的自主性分级与基于实测数据的harness指标基线。

Abstract: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauthenticated local mutation surface. Second, we run a prototype of our system on 45 real coding-agent sessions (102,233 records, 20,577 tool executions, 2,336 human-to-agent episodes). With a blind-audited classifier (precision 83.3% and 96.7%) we estimate that 23.4% (95% CI 17.1 to 35.7) of code-editing episodes end with no independent check after the last edit, and that 57.8% of to-dos the agent marked complete after editing had no proof in between. A 10-minute timing heuristic for session hand-offs recovers 6 of the 24 session pairs that content lineage links. 42% of sessions run longer than 24 hours, 48.1% of transcript bytes lie past a 2 MiB replay bound, and 1,326 records in 16 sessions contain credential-like strings. Third, we propose Soei (Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent): an acknowledgement-aware event schema, a hash-chained local ledger, a W3C PROV-aligned graph, calibrated inference for attribution and lineage, and a verification layer that keeps a claim of completion apart from proof. On the same corpus the ledger is 20% of raw size, holds no content or credentials, verifies at about 126k events/s, detects tampering and replays deterministically. We position the work against concurrent 2026 proposals and define autonomy levels with evidence gates and harness metrics baselined on our data.

</details>


### [396] [Program Bindings Inside Code Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39489)
*Prateek Kumar Rajput,Yewei Song,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文检验是否可用编译器前端计算的结构信息（AST位置、作用域、定义-使用链接、语法类别）来描述和编辑代码模型隐藏状态：以结构标签分解替换各层隐藏状态，若模型仍正确作答则说明分解保留了关键信息；14个模型中10个（含7个代码模型中的6个）优于位置基线，编辑分解可改变模型输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码语言模型能完成、审查和修复程序，但其隐藏状态中编码的程序结构不可见、不可解释、不可控。作者希望找到一种无需重训练即可描述并干预隐藏状态中程序结构信息的方式，因此提出用编译器前端已有的静态分析信息作为可解释的分解基底。

Method: 对Python程序的每个token，用标准分析器给出其在AST中的位置、作用域、定义-使用链接和语法类别；拟合一种分解，将冻结模型的每个隐藏状态表示为逐token项之和，每项结合token与该结构标签；在每一层用该分解替换模型自身状态并让其预测小程序输出；以同样规模但基于token位置的分解作为基线对照；并通过删除定义-使用链接、以及编辑分解（如重绑定调用参数）进行消融与干预实验。

Result: 静态分析分解在14个模型中的10个（含7个代码模型中的6个）比位置基线更好地保持模型答案；在两个受测模型上删除定义-使用链接会消除大部分优势；编辑分解使StarCoder2-15B在100例中有90例给出编辑后程序的答案，而位置基线仅19例；Qwen2.5系列在多项指标上是例外。

Conclusion: 对多数受测模型而言，标准静态分析既提供了隐藏状态关于程序所编码内容的描述，也提供了无需重训练即可改变该信息的途径；定义-使用链接是关键结构要素；Qwen2.5系列的差异表明该结论并非普遍适用。

Abstract: Code language models complete, review, and repair programs without exposing the program structure encoded in their hidden states. In this paper, we test whether the hidden states of a code model can be described and edited using the information a compiler front end computes. For each token of a Python program, standard analyzers provide its position in the abstract syntax tree, its scope, its definition-use links, and its syntactic category. We fit a decomposition that expresses every hidden state of a frozen model as a sum of one term per token, each combining the token with this structural label, and we replace the model's own states with the decomposition at every layer while it predicts the output of a small program. If the model still answers correctly, the decomposition preserves the information the model uses. We apply this test to 14 open models, seven of them trained for code, and compare against a baseline decomposition of the same size built from token positions. The static-analysis decomposition preserves the model's answers better than the positional one in 10 of the 14 models, including six of the seven code models, and deleting the definition-use links from it removes most of that advantage on the two models tested. Editing the decomposition, for instance rebinding the argument of a call, makes StarCoder2-15B produce the answer of the edited program in 90 of 100 cases, compared with 19 for the positional baseline. The Qwen2.5 family is the exception on several measures. For most of the models tested, standard static analysis therefore provides both a description of what the hidden states encode about a program and a way to change it without retraining.

</details>


### [397] [When Static Reachability Says No: Checking Joern-Based Negative Verdicts for Python Against Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39504)
*Artur Zięba-Kozarzewski,Bartosz Grzegorzewski*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文检验静态可达性"不可达"判决与真实执行的一致性：在asciinema中Joern/Semgrep判为不可达的123个函数有113个实际被执行，说明负向判决不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 负向可达性判决会直接把静态分析发现移出人工审查，若判决错误则安全问题被漏检。作者因此用动态执行来校验这类"不可达"结论是否可靠。

Method: 构建SourceLens流水线：将Semgrep发现映射到Python调用图，调用图边取自Joern代码属性图中链接的调用；在PyCG宏基准中手工调用图与Joern不一致的两个命令行程序上做覆盖率执行并记录真实调用；分析缺失调用（通过传值传递的类/函数、with块与属性读取等无调用表达式的调用）；提出将负向判决转为"unknown"的规则。

Result: asciinema中123个不可达函数有86个被项目集成脚本执行、113个被全部运行覆盖；Sublist3r中19/24被执行；仅4条缺失边使113个被执行函数中50个可达；unknown规则分别恢复62/113和15/19（多为dunder与私有方法名），但对5个位于已执行函数中的安全发现恢复0个；选择性无法度量（仅10和5个负向判决未被执行），且在库入口点模型下所有负向判决均退化。

Conclusion: 静态负向可达性判决与真实执行严重不符，不应据此自动移除审查发现；建议将负向判决降级为unknown，但该规则对安全发现无效且依赖入口点模型，需要更精确的调用图与选择性评估。

Abstract: A negative reachability verdict removes a finding from human review. We check such verdicts against execution. Our pipeline, SourceLens, maps Semgrep findings to a Python program's call graph, whose edges a query takes from the calls that Joern links in its code property graph. We ran two command-line programs from the PyCG macro-benchmark, in which the benchmark's manual call graph and Joern disagree, under coverage and recorded the calls between their functions. On these edges, 123 functions of asciinema are unreachable from the program's entry points. The project's own integration script executes 86 of them, and all our runs 113. In Sublist3r, 19 of 24 are executed. The latest Joern release gives the same verdicts. The missing calls go through values, such as classes and functions passed around, or have no call expression, as in with blocks and property reads. In asciinema, four missing edges make 50 of the 113 executed functions reachable. The manual call graphs also lack observed calls, in asciinema many of them property reads and with blocks, which the benchmark may not count as calls. A rule that turns negative verdicts into unknown recovers 62 of the 113 and 15 of the 19, mostly through dunder and private method names. It recovers 0 of the 5 security findings with a negative verdict, all in executed functions. Its selectivity cannot be measured, as only 10 and 5 negative verdicts were not executed, and under library entry-point models it degrades every negative verdict.

</details>


### [398] [Lost in the Latent Space: How Code Embeddings Represent Functional Intent and Implementation Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39519)
*Lu Sun,Yuheng Huang,Lei Ma,Zhijie Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对14个主流代码嵌入模型进行大规模实证研究，通过监督探针、零样本检索与受控扰动三类分析刻画其表征行为，揭示"抽象—保真"张力，认为单一通用代码表征难以实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码嵌入模型已被广泛用于各类软件工程任务，但其内部表征机制理解不足；已有评估多聚焦下游任务性能，难以判断单一嵌入能否同时支持功能抽象与实现敏感分析。

Method: 对14个SOTA代码嵌入模型开展大规模实证研究，采用三种互补分析：(1) 监督探针，评估功能抽象能力与实现保真度；(2) 零样本检索实验，考察嵌入空间的几何相似性；(3) 受控扰动实验，测量模型对语义保持型代码变换的嵌入响应。

Result: 发现一致的"抽象—保真"张力：更善于保留风格与结构信号的模型以牺牲语义泛化为代价；检索性能相近的模型对相同实现变更的响应可能显著不同。

Conclusion: 单一通用代码表征难以实现，需要在软件工程中开展更具表征意识的模型评估、选择与部署。

Abstract: Code embedding models have become a key building block for many software engineering applications, yet their internal representations remain poorly understood. Existing evaluations tend to focus on downstream task performance, offering limited insight into whether a single embedding can support both functional abstraction and implementation-sensitive analysis. To address this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of 14 state-of-the-art code embedding models. We evaluate their representational behavior through three complementary analyses: supervised probing for functional abstraction and implementation fidelity, zero-shot retrieval experiments to assess geometric similarity, and controlled perturbation experiments that measure embedding responses to semantics-preserving code transformations. The results reveal a consistent abstraction-fidelity tension: models that better preserve stylistic and structural signals tend to do so at the expense of semantic generalization, while models with similar retrieval performance can nevertheless respond very differently to the same implementation changes. Overall, our findings suggest that a single universal code representation remains out of reach, motivating more representation-aware evaluation, selection, and deployment of code embedding models in software engineering.

</details>


### [399] [Early Prediction of Cross-Service Implementation Scope: Evidence and Limits from Multiple Microservice Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39640)
*Zhoumaocuo,Xiaozhou Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文基于13个开源微服务项目的866个可追溯特性请求，考察实现前能否预测跨服务改动范围。结果：跨服务改动占11.7%、代码churn更高但lead time无差异；预测信号有限（最佳LOSO模型Macro-F1=0.484，Holm校正后不显著），本地LLM无增益，工作量估计难以优于中位数基线；故实现前证据仅适合轻量triage而非自动化判定或精确估算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务架构的设计初衷是局部化变更，但特性请求的实现常跨越服务边界。作者希望回答一个实践性问题：在实现开始之前，能否从特性请求的早期证据预判这种"下游范围"（跨服务改动）及其工作量，从而支撑范围triage与规划。

Method: 构建issue–pull request–commit可追溯链路，并经定向人工裁定修正实现证据；重建13个开源微服务项目中的866个仓库可追溯特性请求，并将实现映射到经验证的服务边界。据此描述跨服务改动的频率与实现足迹（代码churn、lead time），并评估实现前证据的预测能力：采用留一系统（LOSO）与项目宏平均Macro-F1，与多数类基线及Holm多重比较校正对比，检验小折敏感性；同时比较经典学习模型、本地LLM以及简单的"服务提及"启发式。

Result: 101个请求（11.7%）发生跨服务改动，其实现足迹更广，尤其代码churn更高，但lead time无明显差异。实现前证据的跨项目预测信号有限：最强LOSO模型的项目宏Macro-F1为0.484，相对多数类基线的优势经Holm校正后不显著，且对评估折数较小敏感。本地LLM较经典模型无可靠提升；下游工作量的估计显著更难，学习模型未能稳定优于训练折中位数基线；简单服务提及启发式与学习式范围triage表现相当。

Conclusion: 特性请求的早期证据更适合支持轻量级的跨服务范围triage，而非自动化范围判定或精确工作量估计；研究同时给出了跨服务改动频率与足迹的实证刻画，提示后续工作需在更强的早期信号与更稳健的评估设计上推进。

Abstract: Microservice architectures aim to localize change, yet feature requests may require implementation across service boundaries. We investigate how well such downstream scope can be anticipated before implementation begins. Using issue--pull-request--commit traceability and implementation evidence corrected through targeted human adjudication, we reconstruct 866 repository-traceable feature requests from 13 open-source microservice projects and map their implementations to validated service boundaries. Cross-service changes occur in 101 requests (11.7%) and exhibit broader implementation footprints, particularly higher code churn, but no clear difference in lead time. Pre-implementation evidence provides limited cross-project predictive signal: the strongest leave-one-system-out model reaches a project-macro Macro-F1 of 0.484, but its advantage over the majority baseline is not significant after Holm correction and is sensitive to small evaluation folds. A local LLM offers no reliable improvement over classical models. Downstream workload is substantially harder to estimate, as learned models do not consistently outperform training-fold median baselines. A simple service-mention heuristic also performs comparably to learned scope triage. These findings show that early feature-request evidence is more useful for lightweight cross-service scope triage than for automated scope determination or precise workload estimation.

</details>


### [400] [STORY2DIFF: A Dataset Linking Real-World User Stories to Code Changes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39872)
*Benedetta Donato,Daniele Franchini,Alessandro Greco,Oliviero Riganelli,Daniela Micucci,Leonardo Mariani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出STORY2DIFF数据集，包含7,785条英文用户故事及其对应的已合并Pull Request，来自982个公开Java与Python仓库，每条记录含原始issue、Connextra要素、PR与commit元数据、文件级diff及变更前后文件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求到代码（requirements-to-code）任务需要"真实需求—实现变更"配对的样本，但现有用户故事集合多为孤立或合成文本，缺乏与真实代码变更的链接。

Method: 从982个公开Java/Python仓库中，挖掘2017年1月至2026年7月的用户故事并将其与已合并PR关联；对每条记录抽取Connextra要素（角色、活动、目标/收益），并采集原始issue、PR与commit元数据、PR引入的文件级diff以及变更前后的受影响文件；同时提供可复用的挖掘工具流水线，支持更换参数（如时间范围）重复抽取。

Result: 构建了含7,785条英文用户故事—PR配对记录的数据集（STORY2DIFF，V4.0.1），并提供挖掘工具与演示视频；数据集可用于需求发现、可追溯性、变更影响估计和需求感知代码生成等任务。

Conclusion: STORY2DIFF弥补了现有用户故事数据缺乏真实代码变更链接的空白，且其可复现的挖掘流水线支持按不同参数扩展与更新，为需求工程与LLM代码生成研究提供实证基础。

Abstract: Research on requirements-to-code tasks needs examples in which a genuine requirement is paired with the change that implemented it. Existing user-story collections, however, largely contain isolated or synthetic text. To address this limitation, we present STORY2DIFF, a dataset of 7,785 English user stories linked to merged pull requests from January 2017 to July 2026. The dataset is mined from a set of 982 public Java and Python repositories. Each record in the dataset combines the original issue, extracted Connextra elements, the associated pull request and commit metadata, a file-level diff capturing the code changes introduced by the associated pull request, and the affected files before and after the change. The tool we built to mine STORY2DIFF can be used to repeat the automatic extraction of the records, using different parameters (e.g., a different timeframe). The dataset can support a variety of tasks, including requirement discovery, traceability, change- impact estimation, and requirements-aware code generation. Dataset: https://github.com/riganelli/user-story-mining-pipeline/ releases/tag/V4.0.1. Video: https://youtu.be/qOhXUeyeiTQ.

</details>


### [401] [PR4Code: A Pull Requests Dataset for AI Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39890)
*Benedetta Donato,Leonardo Mariani,Daniela Micucci,Oliviero Riganelli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出PR4Code，一个从GitHub采集的、含4,508个Java与8,831个Python Pull Request的数据集，每个PR附带元数据、提交历史与细粒度代码变更，用于支持从代码补全走向完整功能实现的AI代码生成评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代码生成正从局部代码补全任务转向完整软件功能实现，而现有资源多聚焦于孤立代码片段，缺乏能刻画真实功能实现过程的规模化评测数据，因此需要构建以PR为单位的真实开发任务数据集。

Method: 从GitHub采集4,508个Java与8,831个Python PR，为每个PR标注元数据、提交历史及详细代码变更（diff），并公开数据再生成与更新脚本以保证可复现性与可维护性；同时对PR结构、提交粒度与文本内容进行统计分析。

Result: 构建了跨两种语言、共13,339个真实PR的数据集，分析发现PR在结构、提交粒度与文本内容上存在显著差异；脚本化流程保障了数据集的可复现与持续更新。

Conclusion: PR4Code以真实PR为载体补充了面向功能实现的评测资源，可作为评估AI驱动软件实现方案的规模化、多样化基准数据基础。

Abstract: AI-driven code generation is evolving from handling small, localized code-completion tasks toward supporting the implementation of full software features. To support this transition, this paper introduces PR4Code, a dataset of 4,508 Java and 8,831 Python curated Pull Requests (PRs) collected from GitHub, each enriched with metadata, commit histories, and detailed code changes. Unlike resources focused on isolated code fragments, PR4Code captures the feature implementation process, delivering a large and diverse collection of real-world development tasks that can be used to assess AI-driven solutions. Our analysis reveals substantial variability in PR structure, commit granularity, and textual content. In addition, we release scripts to regenerate and update the dataset, ensuring reproducibility and maintainability.

</details>


### [402] [ExploreRepair: Evidence-Specialized Agents for Vulnerability Repair under Information Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39899)
*Duc Manh Tran,Ratnadira Widyasari,Ivana Clairine Irsan,Huihui Huang,Ting Zhang,David Lo,Rahul Gopinath,Hong Jin Kang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExploreRepair，一个在缺乏漏洞分类与 PoV 测试等不完整信息下，通过多探索智能体的观测与修复实现进行聚合与调和来完成自动漏洞修复的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动漏洞修复常需在不完整漏洞信息下工作：开发者可能缺少准确的漏洞分类或 PoV 测试，但仍需产出补丁。在此情况下，关键挑战在于在确定修复方案前需探索漏洞的多种可能解释。

Method: 由三个智能体各负责探索漏洞的一个特定维度，收集其观测与修复实现；随后 Lesson Aggregator 与 Patch Aggregator 分别基于观测和具体实现独立综合修复方案；最后由最终 Aggregator 在不依赖基准反馈的情况下调和两者的提案。

Result: 在 PatchEval 上，使用 GPT-5.6-Luna 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 分别达到 39.6% 与 71.6% 的修复成功率，较 SOTA 方法 EvoRepair 分别高 16.0 与 25.4 个百分点；在 VulnLoc+ 上分别达 51.4% 与 62.9%，较无 PoV 测试的 LoopRepair 变体高 20.0 与 17.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 基于多智能体多视角探索与双层聚合的调和机制，可在信息不完整且无基准反馈条件下显著提升漏洞修复成功率，优于现有主流方法。

Abstract: Automated vulnerability repair must often operate with incomplete vulnerability information: developers may lack an accurate vulnerability classification or a provided proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) test, yet still need to produce a repair. Without detailed information, a key challenge is to explore multiple plausible interpretations of the vulnerability before committing to a repair. To address this challenge, we propose ExploreRepair, a vulnerability repair framework that reconciles the vulnerability observations and repair implementations from a team of exploration agents. We first collect these observations and repair implementations from three agents, each tasked with exploring a specific dimension of the vulnerability. Then, a Lesson Aggregator and a Patch Aggregator independently synthesize repairs from these observations and concrete implementations before a final Aggregator reconciles their proposals without benchmark feedback. On PatchEval, ExploreRepair achieves repair success rates of 39.6% and 71.6% with GPT-5.6-Luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, exceeding EvoRepair, a state-of-the-art vulnerability repair approach, by 16.0 and 25.4 percentage points. On VulnLoc+, it achieves success rates of 51.4% and 62.9%, respectively, exceeding LoopRepair's variant without PoV tests by 20.0 and 17.1 percentage points.

</details>


### [403] [UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40042)
*Peter Dolog,Kim G. Larsen,Marius Mikučionis,Frederik F. K. Rasmussen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: UPPAAI 是 UPPAAL 的 LLM 增强扩展，以"用户请求、LLM 提议与编排、UPPAAL 验证"为原则，通过 Tools API 暴露编辑器、查询与验证器，使建模、属性刻画、技术选择与反例解释在对话中迭代完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UPPAAL 三十余年来支撑实时与信息物理系统建模分析，但构建合适模型、形式化目标属性、选择分析技术、解读反例仍是需大量专业知识的高度迭代任务；LLM 虽能给出貌似合理的解释与方案，却不保证正确，因此需要将生成能力与形式化验证的可信性结合。

Method: 提出 UPPAAI：在 UPPAAL 中引入与 LLM 的对话式交互，用于模型构建、解释、调试与属性规约；核心设计是职责分离——用户提出请求，LLM 负责提议、解释与工具编排，UPPAAL 负责验证；实现上通过 Tools API 将 UPPAAL 编辑器、查询系统与验证器对外暴露，供 LLM 调用。

Result: 报告了七项案例研究，覆盖面向新手的模型解释、控制器学习，以及时间自动机、随机混合自动机与策略学习等场景。评估显示 LLM 不仅有助于生成解决方案，还能主动建议用户未提及但相关的 UPPAAL 功能，实用性显著。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 的对话式生成与解释能力置于形式化验证器的最终裁决之下，可在保持可信度的同时降低 UPPAAL 的使用门槛并提升迭代效率；"LLM 编排、验证器把关"的架构是 LLM 辅助形式化方法的一种可行范式。

Abstract: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in not just generating solutions but also pro-actively suggesting relevant UPPAAL features it was not asked about.

</details>


### [404] [Unraveling the Efficacy of Neuron Coverage Criteria on Testing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40234)
*Xiaoning Ren,Jiayang Song,Chongyang Liu,Jie Li,Lei Ma,Yinxing Xue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 系统评估六种神经元覆盖准则在Transformer语言模型上的有效性，发现其对错误揭示能力有限，但在分布多样性与样本公平性评估上有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元覆盖准则常用于评估测试集质量与指导测试输入生成，但其对Transformer类语言模型是否有效尚不明确，需要系统验证。

Method: 选取四种已有准则与两种近期准则共六种，在仅编码器、仅解码器、编码器-解码器三类模型上，从错误揭示能力、分布多样性、样本公平性（类别多样性）及测试输入生成指导四个维度进行评估，共33种配置。

Result: 错误样本相对噪声样本仅带来0.32%的额外覆盖，对对抗性错误敏感度低；覆盖准则在33种配置中的26种和30种分别有效评估分布多样性与样本公平性；将神经元级覆盖引导融入测试输入生成仅使对抗样本产出提升4.56%。

Conclusion: 现有覆盖准则可用于评估多样性，但在揭示对抗性错误方面作用有限，单独使用时尤为明显；其实际价值取决于有限收益能否抵消大模型测试的计算开销，亟需面向Transformer的更鲁棒、高效的覆盖准则。

Abstract: Neuron coverage criteria aim to assess test suite quality and guide test input generation, but their effectiveness for Transformer-based language models remains unclear. We evaluate six criteria, including four established and two recent criteria, across encoder-only, decoder-only, and encoder-decoder models. Our evaluation examines error-revealing capability, distribution diversity, sample fairness (category diversity), and guidance for test input generation. The results reveal uneven effectiveness. Erroneous samples provide only 0.32% additional coverage over noise samples, indicating limited sensitivity to adversarial errors. By contrast, coverage criteria effectively assess distribution diversity and sample fairness in 26 and 30 of 33 configurations, respectively. Incorporating neuron-wise coverage guidance into test input generation increases adversarial sample production by only 4.56%. These findings suggest that existing coverage criteria can serve as an antidote for assessing diversity but remain largely a placebo for revealing adversarial errors, particularly when used individually. Their practical value therefore depends on whether these limited benefits justify the computational overhead of testing large Transformer-based models. Our study highlights the need for more robust and efficient coverage criteria tailored to these models, with stronger error-revealing capability and greater value for test generation.

</details>


### [405] [When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40256)
*Yishuo Cai,Minzheng Wang,Liang Zhao,Linghao Zhang,Lei Li,Shicheng Li,Xu Sun,Fuli Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CodeSpecWeave：面向长程软件开发的多维规格合成框架，通过合成智能体与审核智能体协同生成耦合任务需求与可执行测试，构建4,670个训练任务及100任务/1,044条规格的基准，RL训练后显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实长程软件开发要求编码智能体同时满足接口兼容、错误处理等多维规格且不破坏既有依赖；现有工作规格数量与多样性不足，偏重主目标而忽略复杂约束。

Method: 合成任务的两大挑战是：朴素叠加规格会使任务退化为清单式检查而非联合推理；验证细粒度交互易漏检隐藏缺陷或误杀有效替代实现。为此提出CodeSpecWeave：以真实开发者种子为基础，合成智能体迭代开发相互耦合的任务需求与可执行测试，审核智能体对多模型解题轨迹进行审计以保证测试可靠性。

Result: 覆盖2,865个仓库构建4,670个训练任务；在其上做强化学习，在DeepSWE-v1.1上相对基座模型显著提升并大幅优于现有基线；另构建CodeSpecWeave-Bench（100任务、1,044条规格），可清晰区分前沿模型，并揭示处理相互依赖工程约束仍有显著提升空间。

Conclusion: 多维耦合规格的任务合成与轨迹审计相结合，可有效提升编码智能体的多约束满足能力，并提供具备区分度的评测基准以暴露剩余性能提升空间。

Abstract: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial checklists rather than compelling joint reasoning, and verifying these subtle interactions risks overlooking hidden flaws or rejecting valid alternatives. To address these challenges, we introduce CodeSpecWeave, a framework for synthesizing tasks with rich, interdependent specifications. Grounded in real developer seeds, a synthesis agent iteratively develops both coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to guarantee test reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct 4,670 training tasks across 2,865 repositories. Applying Reinforcement learning on these tasks significantly improves performance over the base model on DeepSWE-v1.1, largely outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we curate CodeSpecWeave-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 100 tasks and 1,044 specifications, which clearly separates frontier models and reveals significant headroom in handling interdependent engineering constraints.

</details>


### [406] [When Modernization Breaks Working Code: A Single-File Study of LLMs on Legacy PHP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40269)
*Afridi Mahmud,Abid Hasan Khondaker,Sadif Ahmed,Md Nafiu Rahman,Rifat Shahriyar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文在单文件、无项目上下文、无执行反馈的设定下，用5个LLM将100个WordPress 4.0 PHP文件现代化至PHP 8.3，并以630项隐藏行为检查与511项Rector现代化发现衡量，与"不改动的原始文件"和规则工具Rector对比，发现LLM现代化普遍造成不必要的行为破坏，主张评测须设"不改动基线"并分离报告现代化程度与行为保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "把遗留文件粘进LLM让它现代化"已是常见捷径，但缺乏证据说明结果是否优于原样保留。作者试图量化LLM代码现代化的真实收益与风险，并指出当前评测（只看现代化程度）会误导结论。

Method: 单文件设定：5个LLM分别将100个WordPress 4.0 PHP文件升级到PHP 8.3，要求保持行为，且不提供项目上下文与执行反馈。用630项隐藏行为检查（behavioral checks）和511项Rector检测的现代化发现（findings）评估每个输出。基线有两个：未改动原文与规则工具Rector。进一步区分"PHP 8.3下必须修改"的发现与无需修改的兼容文件，分别统计回归率。

Result: 不修改时83个文件已通过全部检查；最佳LLM仅剩59个。各模型破坏32–51个原本可用的文件，最多修复10个；Rector破坏7个、修复6个。511项发现中仅37项（7%）在PHP 8.3下必须改动，但在无需改动的兼容文件中LLM仍破坏36–60%（Rector为8%）。现代化得分最高的模型与最接近的竞争者在兼容性上并无优势。多数回归检查源于文件完全无法加载，常由PHP本身拒绝的类型声明导致——这类错误无需项目上下文即可避免。

Conclusion: 对遗留单文件的LLM"现代化"往往弊大于利，损害多为不必要且属可避免的低级错误。因此LLM现代化评测应以"不改动基线"为参照，并将现代化程度与行为保持分别报告，避免高现代化分数掩盖行为回归。

Abstract: Pasting a legacy file into an LLM and asking it to "modernize this" is an easy shortcut. But is the result better than leaving the code alone? In this paper, we study this single-file setting with five LLMs, each asked to modernize 100 WordPress 4.0 PHP files to PHP 8.3 while preserving behavior, with no project context or execution feedback. We evaluate every output with 630 hidden behavioral checks and 511 Rector-detected modernization findings. We compare against two baselines: the unchanged originals and the rule-based tool Rector. Often, the answer is no. Untouched, 83 files already pass every check; the best LLM leaves only 59. Each model breaks 32-51 working files while repairing at most 10, whereas Rector breaks 7 and repairs 6. Most of this damage is unnecessary. Only 37 findings (7 percent) require a change under PHP 8.3, yet in compatible files with no required change, the LLMs break 36-60 percent (Rector: 8 percent). The model with the highest modernization score is no more compatible than its closest competitors. Most regressed checks come from files that no longer load at all, often because of type declarations PHP itself rejects. These are errors that need no project context to avoid. Evaluations of LLM-based modernization should therefore measure against a no-change baseline and report modernization and behavioral preservation separately.

</details>


### [407] [Manual binding and semi-automated interface generation for efficient simulation backends with user-friendly frontends: A~demonstration for epidemic use cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40343)
*Maximilian Betz,Daniel-Michel Richter,Daniel Abele,René Schmieding,Henrik Zunker,Martin J. Kühn*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对传染病建模中C/C++后端性能与Python/R易用性之间的矛盾，提出通过抽象语法树分析C++代码以半自动生成Python绑定接口的方法，将大型软件框架高效暴露给Python。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学软件面临的挑战与所用编程语言直接相关。脚本语言（如Python、R）门槛低、便于交互式建模与快速原型开发，但性能不足——在传染病建模中，C/C++实现可比纯Python/R快1至3个数量级；而疫情期间对系统动态的快速估计使非编译语言难以支撑大规模模型。虽可用绑定库从Python调用已编译框架来弥合应用与计算领域之间的鸿沟，但在模型迭代开发、扩展或新增模型时，手工编写绑定代码又成为C/C++后端开发者的新障碍。

Method: 将带有大量传染病模型的大型软件框架高效暴露给Python；提出通过抽象语法树（AST）分析通用C++代码来半自动生成接口代码，形成基于中间表示（intermediate representations）的模块化方法。

Result: 实现了一个大型传染病建模框架与Python的高效对接，并以半自动化方式生成接口代码，降低了绑定开发负担。

Conclusion: 基于AST分析的半自动绑定生成可在保持C/C++后端性能优势的同时提供Python的易用性，并以模块化、可维护的方式缓解迭代开发中接口维护的障碍。

Abstract: Challenges and chances of mathematical software are directly entangled with the programming language used. Depending on the background of developers and users, conflicts between different goals may arise. While several, e.g., scripting languages allow a low barrier and user-friendly entry to mathematical modeling and simulation, corresponding implementations will most likely not allow timely outcomes for detailed simulations.
  In infectious disease modeling, while several large-scale software frameworks rely on C or C++ implementations, most models are implemented in Python or R. While the latter allow for fast prototyping and more interactive development, it has been shown for several applications that C or C++ implementations outperform plain Python or R implementations by factors between one and three orders of magnitude. In particular, in times of pandemics, the urgent need for swift estimation of the system's dynamics makes the use of large-scale models in these noncompiled languages prohibitive.
  In order to create synergies and close the gap between scientists from the application and the computational domain, binding libraries allow to execute entire, compiled software frameworks from languages such as Python. However, with iterative model development, extension, or addition of new models, implementing bindings can represent another relevant barrier to developers of the C or C++ backends. In this paper, we show how a large-scale software framework with a multitude of infectious disease models can be efficiently exposed to Python. In addition, we suggest a semi-automated way to generate interface code by analyzing generic C++ code through abstract syntax trees, enabling a modularized approach working with intermediate representations.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [408] [After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37695)
*Bo Zou,Chao Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 以2026年"一键视频"现象为切入点，论证AI降低服务型内容门槛将改变内容产业结构：服务型/作品型内容比例失衡叠加注意力总量固定的分层试看机制，会使推荐池机制在内容量超过某一倍数后失效，并提出"伯乐系统"式的双轨把关方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 澄清"一键视频"表面上是个体创作力提升这一常见解读的不足，指出其深层影响在于内容产业结构的变化，并说明推荐分发机制为何会在此条件下失灵。

Method: 定性分析＋简化数学模型。提出服务型内容与作品型内容的二分框架：AI对两者均提速，但服务型内容供给无人数上限，作品型受"有话可说"者数量约束，故两者比例渐趋失衡；结合免费平台分层试看（层层筛选）消耗用户注意力、注意力总量固定且被稀释的假设，构建简化模型推导推荐池的失效阈值。

Result: 模型显示：在上述条件成立的前提下，当新增内容增长超过某一倍数时，推荐池机制将失效；同时比例失衡会进一步稀释优质内容的可见度。

Conclusion: 提出"伯乐系统"作为可能出路：由机器与准入规则判定服务型内容是否达标，由可信的人判定作品型内容；并对两类内容此后的演化方向作出简要展望。

Abstract: In September 2026, a new large language model was released. Soon after, a new way of making explainer videos became very popular: people asked the model to write a program, and the program produced the video. "One-click video" content then appeared in large amounts on many platforms. On the surface, this is a rise in creative power at the level of the individual. We argue that, at a deeper level, it changes the structure of the content industry. This judgment rests on two observations. First, this wave of content is service-type content. People watch it to meet a need, not to enjoy the content itself. The other kind is work-type content. AI makes both kinds faster to produce. But anyone can come in and make service-type content, while work-type content is limited by the number of people who have something to say. So the ratio between the two slowly becomes unbalanced. Second, free platforms choose content through layers of trial viewing, and this uses up user attention. The total amount of attention is fixed. The unbalanced ratio also dilutes good content. A simplified mathematical model shows that, as long as these conditions hold, the recommendation pool mechanism will fail once new content grows past a certain multiple. Based on this, we discuss one possible way out. Machines and entry rules judge whether service-type content passes the bar. Trusted people judge work-type content. We call this the BoLe system. At the end, we briefly imagine how the two kinds of content may develop from here.

</details>


### [409] [chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37697)
*Joe Egan,Ben Elliot,Samuel Van Stroud,Alex Sopio,Ki Ryeong Park,Daniele Dal Santo,Zhaohui Li,Runze Li,Jeremy Couthures,Joe George,Cary Randazzo,Juerg Beringer,Daniel Murnane,Gabriel Facini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: chATLAS：面向CERN ATLAS实验的已部署RAG助手，基于混合稠密-稀疏检索覆盖3万余份内部文档，经领域微调与上下文检索将技术性最强文档源的首位命中率提升逾一倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型科学协作产生的内部文档分散于异构系统，协作者难以定位与复用既有知识；且这些专有内容多为通用大模型无法覆盖。

Method: 构建chATLAS系统：基于CERN基础设施部署稠密-稀疏混合检索，接入30,000+文档；采用自动生成问答对构建领域基准，用于评测与设计决策；系统研究嵌入模型选型与领域微调、上下文检索（contextual retrieval）、排序策略与生成器选择；并集成意图路由、安全处理、Mattermost接入及面向智能体工作流的MCP服务器。

Result: 微调结合上下文检索使最具技术挑战性文档源上正确文档作为Top-1结果的返回率提升一倍以上；基准结果指导了检索与生成各环节的设计选择。

Conclusion: 领域适配的RAG可为协作知识提供带来源溯源的领域专有访问，为科学协作组织及其他依赖专有文档准确、实时检索的机构提供可落地基础。

Abstract: Large scientific collaborations produce extensive internal documentation spread across heterogeneous systems, making it difficult for collaborators to locate and reuse existing knowledge. We present chATLAS, a deployed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant developed for the ATLAS experiment at CERN. The system provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources, material largely unavailable to general-purpose language models, using hybrid dense--sparse retrieval deployed on CERN infrastructure. A domain-specific benchmark built from automatically generated question--answer pairs is used to evaluate retrieval and generation performance and to guide design choices. We study the selection and domain-specific fine-tuning of an embedding model, contextual retrieval, ranking strategies, and generator choice. Fine-tuning combined with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source. The deployed system also includes intent routing, safety handling, Mattermost integration, and an MCP server for future agentic workflows. chATLAS demonstrates that domain-adapted RAG can provide source-attributed, domain-specific access to collaboration knowledge, and offers a practical foundation for scientific collaborations and other organisations that rely on accurate, up-to-date retrieval from proprietary documentation.

</details>


### [410] [DuQUAD: A Dual-View Framework with Quality-Aware Evidence Pruning for Multi-Document Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37701)
*Yeonjun Choi,Seyeon Jeong,Jong Wook Kim,Beakcheol Jang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DuQUAD：通过双视角推理与质量感知证据剪枝，缓解多文档问答中的“Lost in the Middle”位置偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG大模型在多文档上下文中系统性忽视中部证据（Lost in the Middle）；现有重排序、注意力引导等方法在噪声场景下脆弱，相关性估计不准与虚假文档仍会掩盖中部有效证据。

Method: 提出DuQUAD框架：由结构融合分数（Structural Fusion Score）引导的局部Agent负责定向证据回收，全局Agent对全部文档进行推理以提供整体语境理解；并引入显式质量评分过滤候选证据，再做句子级细化以抑制噪声。

Result: 在多个强基线（混合检索与重排序、多智能体推理、上下文优化方法）上稳定领先，平均准确率提升3.0%，金标证据召回率提升9.4%，且相比现有多智能体框架显著降低计算开销。

Conclusion: 双视角推理结合质量感知剪枝可有效缓解位置偏差并提升噪声鲁棒性，同时兼顾效率，为多文档RAG提供可行方案。

Abstract: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. The framework further filters candidate evidence using explicit quality scoring and refines it at the sentence level to reduce noise. DuQUAD consistently outperforms strong Lost-in-the-Middle mitigation baselines, including hybrid retrieval and reranking, multi-agent reasoning, and context optimization methods, improving accuracy by 3.0% on average over the strongest competing baseline and gold evidence recall by 9.4%, while substantially reducing computational cost compared to existing multi-agent frameworks.

</details>


### [411] [Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37707)
*Yongkang Li,Panagiotis Eustratiadis,Evangelos Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出相关性引导残差校准（RRC），用相关性标注以闭式方式修正谱压缩中各保留方向的权重，在保持压缩器整体谱趋势的前提下提升密集检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱压缩通过投影到较小主子空间降低存储与打分成本，但其基于语料的加权规则把所有保留方向绑定到统一的谱趋势上，未直接考虑各方向对相关性的贡献差异。

Method: RRC为闭式方法：沿每个保留方向，基于正负样本得分贡献的均值与方差估计间隔式（margin-based）权重；保留估计权重为正的方向，将其对数权重分解为拟合的幂律趋势与残差，并在该支撑集上把残差加回压缩器的对数权重。方法适用于PCA、Whitening与SpecTemp，修正并入文档与查询共享的既有变换，无需迭代训练或额外推理阶段。

Result: 三个编码器、九个数据集（常规与推理密集型检索）实验显示：SpecTemp+RRC在BEIR组与BRIGHT上各目标维度均取得测试压缩器中最高的平均有效性；在五个BRIGHT数据集、768维下较SpecTemp平均提升2.34个nDCG@10点；在标量量化与乘积量化下增益仍保持，改善了每文档存储与检索效果的权衡。

Conclusion: 以相关性标注对谱权重的逐方向残差校准是一种低成本、可插拔的改进手段，能在不改变压缩器整体谱结构与推理流程的情况下，稳定提升谱压缩密集检索的有效性。

Abstract: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/

</details>


### [412] [Beyond Similarity Search: Knowledge Graph Metadata Enrichment for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37728)
*Fakabbir Amin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在SEC EDGAR季度快照（167,050份申报、508,714个嵌入块）上，构建430,257节点、561,144边的知识图谱，对比text-to-SQL、稠密向量RAG与两阶段GraphRAG；GraphRAG在20题上三次尝试全部答对16题，显著优于text-to-SQL（10题）和向量RAG（3题），无自信性错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业文档由多团队长期产生，无法用组织文档职责范围之外的最新信息与元数据加以丰富，这使得RAG的信息检索成为关键挑战。作者希望验证：用知识图谱存储元数据与高频变化信息，能否优于基于嵌入的相似度检索。

Method: 以SEC EDGAR一个季度的快照为实验语料（10,511家公司、167,050份申报、508,714个风险因素文本嵌入块）；构建含430,257节点、561,144边、每条边携带accession number的知识图谱以模拟信息丰富化；对比三种架构：类型化列上的text-to-SQL、基于HNSW余弦搜索的稠密向量RAG、两阶段GraphRAG；各架构共用同一模型与温度；由LLM作为评判者程序化打分，20道题分属四类，每题重复三次。

Result: GraphRAG三次尝试均解出20题中的16题，text-to-SQL为10题，向量RAG为3题。GraphRAG在结构化聚合类查询上表现失利；向量RAG在其本应占优的单文档类别中失败（15次仅通过3次，GraphRAG为15/15），原因是在该规模下公司归属无法从余弦相似度中恢复。基准中全部六例自信性错误均来自text-to-SQL，即把同姓的不同人物混为一谈——而"读文本前先将身份解析为标识符"可从结构上避免此类错误，GraphRAG未出现该问题。

Conclusion: 图结构设计通过将身份解析锚定到标识符，在元数据与频繁变化信息的检索上明显优于向量相似度检索与text-to-SQL，但其优势不超出该语料、该模型与该问题集的范围；结构化聚合查询仍是GraphRAG的短板。

Abstract: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine search, and a two-stage GraphRAG design. All architectures share the same model and temperature to allow comparison. Results are scored programmatically by an LLM as judge over 20 questions divided across four categories, each question asked three times. GraphRAG solved 16 of 20 questions on all three attempts, compared to 10 for text-to-SQL and 3 for vector RAG. GraphRAG lost on structured aggregation queries. Vector RAG lost the single-document category it was expected to win, passing 3 of 15 where GraphRAG passed 15 of 15, because company attribution is not recoverable from cosine similarity at this scale. All six confident falsehoods in the benchmark were text-to-SQL conflating distinct people who share a surname, the failure that resolving identity to an identifier before reading any text prevents structurally; GraphRAG made none. We claim no advantage beyond this corpus, this model and this question set.

</details>


### [413] [Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37962)
*Carlos Peláez-González,Francisco Herrera,Andrés Herrera-Poyatos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM式对话推荐系统（基于RAG）中的“位置偏差”，即推荐结果对提示中候选物品排列顺序的系统性依赖，并提出两种检测方法与三项量化指标，在受控测试床上验证该偏差为结构性、可复现的性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM通过RAG充当对话推荐的生成器，这种灵活设计引入了新的结构性偏差来源，而提示中候选呈现顺序是否影响推荐结果尚缺乏系统的检测与量化手段。

Method: 提出两种互补检测方法：(i) POB-ICM，基于列联表分析与卡方独立性检验；(ii) POB-UNBP，基于置换评估下的均匀性零模型，样本高效且支持随机解码并提供形式化统计保证。构建受控RAG产品推荐测试床（真实商品目录、固定提示模板、2000条模板生成查询×20种排列共40000实例）。引入三项指标：排列敏感度、位置偏差、强位置偏差（后者针对位置将推荐推向明显更不相关物品的情形）。并进行候选集规模与解码温度的稳健性分析。

Result: 两种方法在所有评估的SOTA模型上均拒绝位置独立性与均匀性零假设；稳健性分析表明该偏差是结构性的且依赖模型，而非确定性解码或候选集规模的产物。

Conclusion: 在所评估设定下，位置偏差是提示中介推荐流水线中可测量、可复现的性质，需对部署的LLM推荐系统开展常规审计与治理控制（如顺序随机化、标准化提示），代码已公开。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both methodologies reject the null hypothesis of positional independence and uniformity in all evaluated state-of-the-art models. We introduce three complementary metrics -- permutation sensitivity, positional bias, and strong positional bias -- to quantify this effect, the latter targeting cases where the position displaces the recommendation towards clearly less relevant items rather than only choosing among comparably relevant ones. A robustness analysis across candidate-set size and decoding temperature shows that the bias is structural and model-dependent, not an artifact of deterministic decoding or candidate-set size. These results establish positional bias as a measurable, reproducible property of prompt-mediated recommendation pipelines in the evaluated setting and motivate routine auditing and governance controls (e.g., order randomization, standardized prompting) for deployed LLM-based RS. Source code is publicly released.

</details>


### [414] [Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37973)
*Yunqin Zhu,Yao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 Merge and Branch (M&B) 框架，通过压缩历史输入与多目标分支预测，提升 LLM 生成式推荐的训练与解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成式推荐需编码冗长的文本交互历史，却仅生成短语义标识符 (SID)，输入与输出严重不对称；历史编码代价高昂，而每条历史通常只提供一个监督目标，导致监督微调效率低下。

Method: Merge 将每个历史物品的 SID 与文本压缩为少量可学习 token；Branch 用压缩后的历史同时预测多个目标 SID。为在共享历史计算的同时保持各目标独立，将每个样本组织为浅而宽的树结构，并设计 tree FlashAttention 高效执行该布局：共享历史仅计算一次，梯度从所有分支回传以实现端到端训练；进一步用树结构 key/value 缓存将历史共享扩展到受限解码。

Result: 在公开基准上，M&B 优于强推荐基线，并显著提升训练与解码效率。

Conclusion: 通过合并历史表征与分支式多目标监督，并结合树形注意力与 KV 缓存实现，可在不牺牲（甚至提升）推荐效果的前提下大幅降低计算开销，为 LLM 生成式推荐的高效微调提供可行方案。

Abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Experiments on public benchmarks show that M&B outperforms strong recommendation baselines while substantially improving training and decoding efficiency.

</details>


### [415] [Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38090)
*Elisha Bajemon,Andre-Louis Rochet*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式引擎优化（GEO）中的“引用份额”排序问题，系统评测了预训练重排器、托管型类型化决策模型Jev、八个开源决策模型及蒸馏学生模型；发现不同引擎间组内Spearman相关达0.704，Jev与两个27B开源决策模型零样本即最强（0.575–0.578），基于LoRA微调的GEO Citation Ranker 4B达0.542–0.549且与前者差异不显著，并释放模型、基准、全部打分器预测与代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEO需要能够按“页面在答案中被引用的份额”对候选页面排序的打分器，但现有打分器在该任务上的相对能力、以及不同生成式引擎之间的引用行为一致性尚缺乏系统、可复现的实证对比，因此作者构建统一评测以回答“什么样的打分器有效、差距来自何处”。

Method: 在GEO-Bench查询上，由十个引擎在提示中接收相同候选来源作答，以此构造引用标签；对预训练重排器、托管型类型化决策模型Jev、八个开源决策模型及蒸馏学生模型进行统一打分评测；用组内Spearman相关度量引擎间一致性与各打分器准确度；以低秩适配（LoRA）在其他GEO-Bench查询的教师标签上微调Qwen3-Reranker-4B，得到GEO Citation Ranker 4B，并在三个随机种子上验证；进一步做单段落逐条打分的对照实验，比较教师标签与观测引擎引用标签、以及单一教师（Jev）与双教师标签训练的效果。

Result: 引擎间组内Spearman相关为0.704；Jev与两个开源27B决策模型零样本表现最强，为0.575–0.578；GEO Citation Ranker 4B在三个种子上达0.542–0.549，在229条查询上其与27B模型及Jev的差异不可区分于零；当Jev改为与学生一致的单段落打分时，学生与Jev之间的大部分差距消失；用教师标签与用观测引擎引用训练的学生达到同等水平；在0.6B规模下，仅用Jev标签即可匹配双教师目标。

Conclusion: 一个4B的LoRA蒸馏模型即可在GEO引用份额排序上逼近27B决策模型与Jev，差距主要源于打分粒度（逐段落 vs. 整页）而非模型能力；引用标签的来源（教师标签或真实引擎引用）在蒸馏中可互换。作者释放模型、基准、所有报告打分器的预测及代码，支持后续复现与比较。

Abstract: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt.
